RNA_reads <- read.csv(\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/RNA/Statistics/Stats_intestine_plate1_plate2.csv\, sep = \\t\)

#RNA
p <- ggplot(RNA_reads, aes(x =log2(PE_aligned), y =  log2(UMI), color=Dox)) +
  geom_point()+
geom_abline(slope = 1,             # 45-degree line (y = x)
    intercept = 0,         # Start at origin (0,0)
    color = \black\,         # Line color
    linetype = \dashed\,   # Line style (solid/dashed/dotted)
    linewidth = 0.5        # Line thickness
  )+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(\#A50F15\,\#377EB8\,\#4DAF4A\))+
   theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color = \black\),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5, color = \black\),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = \black\, face = \plain\, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y.left  = element_text(size = 11, color = \black\, face = \plain\, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11),
    legend.position = \top\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, \cm\))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  labs(
    title = \\,
    y = \Log2(RNA UMIs)\,
    x = \Log2(Mapped reads)\)
  #ylim(0,7)+
  #xlim(0,7)

  # Save the plot
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)

# Extract all legend boxes
  legends <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == \guide-box\)]

# Save each legend manually (they're stacked in one box)
  legend_combined <- legends[[1]]  # Usually contains both

gDNA_reads3 = gDNA_reads[gDNA_reads$DCM_UMI_wholegene >300, ]
RNA_reads3 = RNA_reads[RNA_reads$UMI >300,  ]
gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag <- abs(gDNA_reads3$DCM_unique - gDNA_reads3$Aligned) / sqrt(2)
gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_CpG <- abs(gDNA_reads3$CpG_unique - gDNA_reads3$Aligned) / sqrt(2)
RNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_RNA <- abs(RNA_reads3$UMI - RNA_reads3$PE_aligned) / sqrt(2)

# Compare red vs blue
dox_dist <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag[gDNA_reads3$Dox == \48hDox\]
minus_dist  <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag[gDNA_reads3$Dox == \Minus\]
chase_dist  <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag[gDNA_reads3$Dox == \48hDox-72hChase\]

dox_dist <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_CpG[gDNA_reads3$Dox == \48hDox\]
minus_dist  <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_CpG[gDNA_reads3$Dox == \Minus\]
chase_dist  <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_CpG[gDNA_reads3$Dox == \48hDox-72hChase\]

dox_dist <- RNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_RNA[RNA_reads3$Dox == \48hDox\]
minus_dist  <- RNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_RNA[RNA_reads3$Dox == \Minus\]
chase_dist  <- RNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_RNA[RNA_reads3$Dox == \48hDox-72hChase\]
# Use a Wilcoxon rank-sum test (non-parametric)
wilcox.test(dox_dist, minus_dist)

# Optional: Visualize
boxplot(distance_to_diag_CpG ~ Dox, data = gDNA_reads,
        main = \Distance to 1:1 Line\,
        ylab = \Distance\, col = c(\red\, \blue\))

gDNA_RNA_stats4_melt$group <- interaction(gDNA_RNA_stats4_melt$variable, gDNA_RNA_stats4_melt$Dox_gDNA, sep = \_\)

library(reshape2)
All_DCM <- data.frame(Position=Chase_all$V1,
                               Plus=Plus_all$Norm_DCM,
                           Chase=Chase_all$Norm_DCM,
                           Minus=Minus_all$Norm_DCM)
All_DCM_melt <- melt(All_DCM, id.vars = \Position\)
All_DCM_melt$variable <- factor(All_DCM_melt$variable, levels = c(\Plus\,\Chase\,\Minus\))

p <- ggplot(All_DCM_melt, aes(x = Position, y = value, color=variable)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +
  ylab(\(DCM Reads / Sites)/DCM depth\)+
  xlab(\\)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 100, 200, 300),
                     labels = c(\\, \TSS\, \TES\,\\))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(\#377EB8\,\#4DAF4A\,\#A50F15\), name = \\)+
    theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color = \black\),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5, color = \black\),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = \black\, face = \plain\, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y.left  = element_text(size = 11, color = \black\, face = \plain\, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11),
    legend.position = \top\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, \cm\))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 1))

  # Save the plot

# Extract all legend boxes
  legends <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == \guide-box\)]

  legend_combined <- legends[[1]]  # Usually contains both

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\all_genes_DCM_metagene_legend.png\),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =2.15, height = 0.2)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = \none\)

chga_expr <- FetchData(Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE, vars = \Chga\)[,1]
summary(chga_expr)
quartiles <- quantile(chga_expr, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
# Compute quartiles
chga_summary <- quantile(chga_expr, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
quartile_group <- cut(
  chga_expr,
  breaks = c(-Inf, quartiles[1], quartiles[2], quartiles[3], Inf),
  labels = c(\Q1\, \Q2\, \Q3\, \Q4\),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)
df <- data.frame(
  expression = chga_expr,
  quartile = quartile_group
)

# Summarize total expression and cell count by quartile
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(quartile) %>%
  summarise(
    total_expression = mean(expression),
    cell_count = n()
  )

# Melt for plotting both metrics side-by-side
summary_long <- summary_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(\total_expression\, \cell_count\),
                      names_to = \metric\, values_to = \value\)

# Barplot
ggplot(summary_long, aes(x = quartile, y = value, fill = metric)) +
  geom_bar(stat = \identity\, position = \dodge\) +
  geom_text(data = subset(summary_long, metric == \cell_count\),
            aes(label = value),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.2),
            vjust = -0.3,
            size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = \CHGA Expression by Quartile\,
       x = \CHGA Expression Quartile\,
       y = \Value\,
       fill = \Metric\) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/andrea_paper/chga_per_quartileCounts_enteroendocrine_subset.png\, dpi=300, width = 5, heigh=3)

Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE

Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE <- RunUMAP(Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE, dims = 1:10, verbose = FALSE)
DimPlot(Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE, group.by = c(\unintegrated_clusters_0.8\,\unintegrated_clusters_0.9\,\unintegrated_clusters_1\,\unintegrated_clusters_1.1\, \unintegrated_clusters_1.11\))
ggsave(\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/andrea_paper/Umap_per_cluster.png\, width = 12, height = 5)
Idents(Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE) <- \unintegrated_clusters_1.1\
Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers <-  FindAllMarkers(Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE) #m

library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(gprofiler2)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(GOSemSim)
library(enrichplot)
cluster<-list()
egos<-list()
clusters<-levels(factor(Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE@meta.data$unintegrated_clusters_1.1))
Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers_sig <- Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers[Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers$p_val<0.05,]

#enrich pathways
unique_clusters <- unique(Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers_sig$cluster)
unique_clusters <- as.factor(c(\1\,\2\,\3\,\4\))
# Initialize a list to store results for each cluster
ego<- list()
ont <- \BP\  # Define ontology

for (p in unique_clusters) {
  # Subset data
  cluster_data <- Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers_sig[Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers_sig$cluster == p, ]
  
  # Gene conversion
  test3 <- gconvert(cluster_data$gene, organism = \mmusculus\, target = \ENSG\, filter_na = TRUE)
  valid_genes <- unique(na.omit(test3$target))
  
  if (length(valid_genes) == 0) {
    message(\No valid gene conversions for cluster \, p)
    next
  }
  
  # GO enrichment
  result <- tryCatch({
    enrichGO(
      gene = valid_genes,
      OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
      keyType = 'ENSEMBL',
      ont = ont,
      pAdjustMethod = \BH\,
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      readable = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(\enrichGO failed for cluster \, p, \: \, e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(result) || nrow(result@result) == 0) {
    message(\No GO enrichment results for cluster \, p)
    next
  }
  
  # Store and visualize
  ego[[as.character(p)]] <- result
  
  if (any(result@result$qvalue <= 0.05)) {
    png(file = paste0(\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/andrea_paper/GO_EEC/\, p, \_\, ont, \.png\), 
        width = 6.8, height = 6, units = \in\, res = 150)
    print(dotplot(result))
    dev.off()
  } else {
    message(\No significant terms for cluster \, p)
  }
}

library(scCATCH)

# Loop through each row in X and update Z$cells based on matching clusters
for (i in 1:nrow(Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE@meta.data)) {

  if (any(matching_row)) {
    Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE@meta.data$scCATCH_label[i] <- EEC_CATCH@celltype$cell_type[matching_row]
  }
}

# Loop through clusters
for (cl in names(feature_list)) {
  gene_set <- feature_list[[cl]]
  genes_found <- intersect(gene_set, available_genes)
  
  if (length(genes_found) == 0) {
    message(\Skipping cluster \, cl, \: no matching genes found.\)
    next
  }
  
  # Generate the plot
  plot <- FeaturePlot(Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE,
                      features = genes_found)
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(filename = paste0(output_dir, \Cluster_\, cl, \_FeaturePlot.png\),
         plot = plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}

## RNA reference dataset Haber
Harber_dataset <- read.table(\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/combinatorial_indexing_chapter/intestine/GSE92332_atlas_UMIcounts.txt\, sep = \\t\)
Large_harber <- read.table(\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/Harber/Large_scRNA/GSE92332_LargeCellSort_UMIcounts.txt\)


Harber_metadata_subset <- Harber_metadata[colnames(Harber_dataset) %in% Harber_metadata$NAME,]
colnames(Harber_dataset) == Harber_metadata_subset$NAME
dim(Harber_metadata_subset)


# Split the column names by \_\
split_names <- strsplit(colnames(Harber_dataset), \_\)


# If you want to include the second part as well (between first and last underscore):
Harber_metadata <- data.frame(
  Batch = sapply(split_names, function(x) x[1]),  # First part
  CellID = sapply(split_names, function(x) x[2]), # Second part
  celltype = sapply(split_names, function(x) x[3]), # Third part
  OriginalID = colnames(Harber_dataset)           # Keep original full name
)

rownames(Harber_metadata) <- Harber_metadata$OriginalID

rownames(Harber_metadata) == colnames(Harber_dataset)

split_names_large <- strsplit(colnames(Large_harber), \_\)

metadata_large <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(Large_harber),
  CellID = sapply(split_names_large, function(x) x[1]),  # First part
  Batch = sapply(split_names_large, function(x) x[2]), # Second part
  Batch2 = sapply(split_names_large, function(x) x[3]),
  celltype = sapply(split_names_large, function(x) x[4]), # Third part
  OriginalID = colnames(Large_harber)           # Keep original full name
)

Harber_dataset_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(Harber_dataset, min.features = 200, min.cells = 3, project = \RNA_Harber\, meta.data = Harber_metadata) %>% # only take cells with more than 2000 genes, can make it more strict (i believe 3000 is \standard\, but really depends on cell type if you ask me)
  PercentageFeatureSet(pattern = \^mt-\, col.name = \percent.mt\)

Large_dataset_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(Large_harber, min.features = 200, min.cells = 3, project = \RNA_Harber\, meta.data = metadata_large) %>% # only take cells with more than 2000 genes, can make it more strict (i believe 3000 is \standard\, but really depends on cell type if you ask me)
  PercentageFeatureSet(pattern = \^mt-\, col.name = \percent.mt\)

integrated_seurat$cell_identity_int <- recode(integrated_seurat$unintegrated_clusters_0.3,
                     \0\ = \ISC\,
                     \1\ = \ISC/TA\,
                     \2\ = \Enterocyte\,
                     \3\ = \ISC\,
                     \4\ = \Goblet\,
                     \5\ = \Paneth\,
                     \6\ = \ISC/TA\,
                     \7\ = \ISC\,
                     \8\ = \Enterocyte\,
                     \9\ = \Tuft\,
                     \10\ = \Enteroendocrine\)
integrated_seurat$cell_identity_int2 <- recode(integrated_seurat$unintegrated_clusters_0.3,
                     \0\ = \ISC\,
                     \1\ = \ISC\,
                     \2\ = \Enterocyte\,
                     \3\ = \ISC\,
                     \4\ = \Goblet\,
                     \5\ = \Paneth\,
                     \6\ = \ISC\,
                     \7\ = \ISC\,
                     \8\ = \Enterocyte\,
                     \9\ = \Tuft\,
                     \10\ = \Enteroendocrine\)

integrated_seurat$Dataset2 <- recode(integrated_seurat$Dataset,
                     \Harber_dataset\ = \Atlas_dataset\,
                     \Large_dataset\ = \Large_dataset\,
                     \pRNA\ = \pRNA\,
                     \pDCM\ = \pDCM\)

integrated_seurat$cell_identity_int2 <- factor(integrated_seurat$cell_identity_int2, levels = c(\ISC\,\Enterocyte\,\Goblet\,\Paneth\,\Tuft\,\Enteroendocrine\))

DimPlot(integrated_seurat, reduction = \umap\, group.by = c(\cell_identity_int2\), cols = publication_colors_27, pt.size = 0.01)  &
   theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    plot.title =  element_blank(),
    axis.text =  element_blank(),
    axis.ticks =  element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line =  element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11),
    legend.position = \right\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, \cm\))
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\UMAP_reference_RNA_DCM_integrated2.png\),dpi=300, width = 3, height = 2)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\UMAP_reference_RNA_DCM_integrated2.pdf\),dpi=300, width = 3, height = 2)

    values = c(\gray\, \gray\, \#117733\, \#990000\),

    axis.title = element_blank(),

    axis.line =  element_blank(),

    legend.position = \right\,

    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, \cm\))
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\UMAP_reference_RNA_DCM_integrated2_dataset.png\), dpi=300, width = 3, height = 2)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\UMAP_reference_RNA_DCM_integrated2_dataset.pdf\), dpi=300, width = 3, height = 2)

```r
integrated_seurat@meta.data$cell_type_int2 <- paste(
  integrated_seurat@meta.data$cell_identity_int2,
  integrated_seurat@meta.data$Dataset2,
  sep = \_\
) %>% as.factor()

# 2. Compute average expression per cell type batch group
avg_exp <- AverageExpression(
  integrated_seurat,
  group.by = \cell_type_int2\,
  assays = \RNA\,  # or whichever assay contains your data
  slot = \scale.data\    # use \counts\ for raw counts
)$RNA

# 3. Compute Pearson correlations
avg_exp <- as.matrix(avg_exp)
cor_matrix <- cor(avg_exp, method = \pearson\)

# Extract cell type and dataset from rownames
cell_info <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(rownames(cor_matrix), \-\))
colnames(cell_info) <- c(\CellType\, \Dataset\,\extra\)
cell_info <- as.data.frame(cell_info)
cell_info$extra <- NULL

# Use the same annotation for both rows and columns
annotation_df <- cell_info
rownames(annotation_df) <- rownames(cor_matrix)
annotation_df$CellType <- factor(annotation_df$CellType, levels=c(\ISC\,\Enterocyte\,\Goblet\,\Paneth\,\Tuft\,\Enteroendocrine\))
annotation_df <- annotation_df[order(annotation_df$CellType), ]

cor_matrix_reorderd <- cor_matrix[rownames(annotation_df), rownames(annotation_df)]

# Define colors (optional: customize these)
ann_colors <- list(
  CellType = setNames(c(\#88CCEE\,  \#117733\, \#999933\, \#44AA99\,\#DDCC77\, 
  \#CC6677\), unique(annotation_df$CellType)),
  Dataset = setNames(c(\gray\, \gray\, \#117733\, \#990000\), unique(annotation_df$Dataset)))
# 4. Plot correlation heatmap
filename = file.path(output_dir,\scaled_correlation_heatmap2.svg\),
  width = 12,
  height = 10,
  units = \in\,
  res = 300)

pdf(file.path(output_dir,\scaled_correlation_heatmap2.pdf\),
  width = 12,
  height = 10)
pheatmap(
  cor_matrix_reorderd,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = F,
  cluster_cols = F,
  #clustering_distance_rows = \correlation\,
  #clustering_distance_cols = \correlation\,
  annotation_row = annotation_df,
  annotation_col = annotation_df,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  border_color = NA,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 11,
  fontsize_col = 11,
  main = \Cell Type Correlation Across Batches\
)
dev.off()

```r
Idents(integrated_seurat) <- \cell_identity_int2\
integrated_seurat_markers <-  FindAllMarkers(integrated_seurat, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.5, only.pos = TRUE) #markers clustered by label
integrated_seurat_markers_DCM <-  FindAllMarkers(subset(integrated_seurat,Dataset == \pDCM\), min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE) 
integrated_seurat_markers_DCM_sub <- integrated_seurat_markers_DCM[integrated_seurat_markers_DCM$avg_log2FC >0.25,]
integrated_seurat_markers_RNA <-  FindAllMarkers(subset(integrated_seurat,Dataset == \pRNA\), min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
integrated_seurat_markers_RNA_sub <- integrated_seurat_markers_RNA[integrated_seurat_markers_RNA$p_val_adj <0.05,]

mm10_DCM_Sites_all3_pRNA <- mm10_DCM_Sites_all3[match(integrated_seurat_markers_RNA_sub$gene, mm10_DCM_Sites_all3$V4),]
integrated_seurat_markers_RNA_sub$DCM_sites <- mm10_DCM_Sites_all3_pRNA$DCM_sites
#DCM sites per cluster histogram
# Get list of unique clusters
clusters <- unique(integrated_seurat_markers_RNA_sub$cluster)

# Loop through each cluster and create/save the plot
for (clust in clusters) {
  # Filter the data for the current cluster
  cluster_data <- integrated_seurat_markers_RNA_sub %>% filter(cluster == clust)
  
  # Create the histogram plot
  p <- ggplot(cluster_data, aes(x = DCM_sites)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 50, fill = \steelblue\, color = \black\) +
    labs(
      title = paste(clust),
      x = \DCM Sites\,
      y = \Gene Count\
    ) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \bold\),
      plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = \bold\, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, face = \bold\, hjust = 1),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \bold\),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.8),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.title = element_text(face = \bold\, size = 11),
      legend.position = \top\,
      legend.box = \horizontal\,
      legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.2, \cm\)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))+
    xlim(0,4000)+
    ylim(0,300)
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir,paste0(\DCMsites_ongenemarkers_distribution_cluster_\, clust, \.png\)),
    plot = p,
    width = 3,
    height = 3,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

```r
#Intersections gene markers between combi and harber
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(VennDiagram)
library(tibble)
pRNA_genes_by_cluster <- integrated_seurat_markers_RNA_sub %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene))) %>%
  deframe()

pDCM_genes_by_cluster <- integrated_seurat_markers_DCM_sub %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene))) %>%
  deframe()

common_clusters_plate <- intersect(names(pRNA_genes_by_cluster), names(pDCM_genes_by_cluster))

# Create a list of gene sets per cluster
gene_sets_per_cluster <- map(common_clusters_plate, function(clust) {
  list(
    pRNA = pRNA_genes_by_cluster[[clust]],
    pDCM  = pDCM_genes_by_cluster[[clust]]
  )
}) %>%
  setNames(common_clusters_plate)


# Label datasets
pRNA_markers <- integrated_seurat_markers_RNA_sub %>%
  mutate(dataset = \pRNA\)

pDCM_markers <- integrated_seurat_markers_DCM_sub %>%
  mutate(dataset = \pDCM\)

# Combine both
all_markers_plate <- bind_rows(pRNA_markers, pDCM_markers) %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_log2FC))  # remove NAs if present


#Module score of intersected genes

intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate <- map(common_clusters_plate, function(clust) {
  pRNA_genes <- integrated_seurat_markers_RNA_sub %>% filter(cluster == clust) %>% pull(gene)
  pDCM_genes  <- integrated_seurat_markers_DCM_sub %>% filter(cluster == clust) %>% pull(gene)
  intersect(pRNA_genes, pDCM_genes)
}) %>% setNames(common_clusters_plate)

# Add module scores for each cluster
# Get unique cluster values
intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate_df <- enframe(intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate, 
                                                 name = \cluster\, value = \gene\) %>%
  unnest(gene)
intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate_df <- as.data.frame(intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate_df)
write.csv(intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate_df,\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/data_for_joachim/marker_genes_per_cluster.csv\, row.names = F)
unique_clusters <- names(intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate)

# Create an empty list to store the final plots for each cluster
plus_fplots <- list()

# Iterate over each cluster
for (cluster in unique_clusters) {
  # Individual module
  module <- intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate[[cluster]]
  
  # Add module scores to the gast object
  integrated_seurat <- AddModuleScore( integrated_seurat, features = list(c(module)), name = paste0(cluster),  nbin = 20, ctrl = 5)
  
  # Generate the feature plot for the current cluster
  plus_fplot <- FeaturePlot(object =  integrated_seurat, reduction = \umap\,features = paste0(cluster, \1\), pt.size = 0.5, cols= c(\white\, \#882255\))
  #scale_colour_gradientn(colours = rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = \RdBu\)))
  
  # Save the plot to the plus_fplots list
  plus_fplots[[paste0(\plus_fplot\, cluster)]] <- plus_fplot
  
  # Save the plots
  ggsave(filename = paste0(\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/Harber/Large_harber_plate_integration/Module_score/overlap_DCM_RNA/\, cluster, \_markers2.png\), plot = plus_fplot, dpi = 300,width = 5, height = 3)

}

library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# Extract meta data
meta_data <- integrated_seurat@meta.data

# Identify module score columns
module_score_cols <- grep(\1\, colnames(meta_data), value = TRUE)
module_score_cols <- module_score_cols[c(3:8)]
# Add cell identity and dataset
plot_df <- meta_data[, c(\cell_identity_int2\, \Dataset\, module_score_cols)]

plot_df2 <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Dataset) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Enterocyte1, Enteroendocrine1, Goblet1, ISC1, Paneth1, Tuft1),
                ~ scale(.)[,1],
                .names = \{.col}_zscore\)) %>%
  ungroup()


plot_df2$Enterocyte1 <- NULL
plot_df2$Enteroendocrine1 <- NULL
plot_df2$ISC1 <- NULL
plot_df2$Goblet1 <- NULL
plot_df2$Paneth1 <- NULL
plot_df2$Tuft1 <- NULL




# Reshape to long format for ggplot
plot_df_long <- melt(plot_df2, id.vars = c(\cell_identity_int2\, \Dataset\),
                     variable.name = \cluster\, value.name = \module_score\)

# Optional: clean cluster names
library(ggpubr)

# Filter for plate DCM
df <- subset(plot_df_long, Dataset == \pDCM\)
df$cluster <- gsub(\1_zscore\, \\, df$cluster)

# Prepare an empty list to collect plots
plots <- list()

# Loop through clusters
for (clust in unique(df$cluster)) {
  
  df_clust <- df %>% filter(cluster == clust)
  
  # Target identity to compare against
  ref_group <- clust  # assuming cluster names match cell_identity_int exactly
  
  # Skip cluster if reference group not present
  if (!(ref_group %in% df_clust$cell_identity_int2)) next
  
  # Create pairwise comparisons: each group vs the cluster's reference group
  identities <- unique(df_clust$cell_identity_int2)
  comparisons <- lapply(setdiff(identities, ref_group), function(other) c(ref_group, other))

  # Add highlight column
  df_clust <- df_clust %>%
    mutate(highlight = ifelse(cell_identity_int2 == ref_group, \Target\, \Rest\))
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(df_clust, aes(x = cell_identity_int2, y = module_score, fill = highlight)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste(clust),
      x = \\,
      y = paste(\Z DCM Module Score\n\,clust)
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(\Target\ = \#D55E00\, \Rest\ = \#0072B2\)) +
    
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method = \wilcox.test\,
      label = \p.signif\,
      tip.length = 0.01
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25)))+
     theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color = \black\),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5, color = \black\),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = \black\, face = \plain\, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y.left  = element_text(size = 11, color = \black\, face = \plain\, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11),
    legend.position = \top\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, \cm\))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 1))+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = \none\)

  plots[[clust]] <- p
}


# Save each plot
for (clust in names(plots)) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir,paste0(\pDCM_MS_target_vs_others_\, gsub(\[/ ]\, \_\, clust), \.pdf\)),
    plot = plots[[clust]],
    width = 3,
    height = 3,
    units = \in\,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

 # Save the plot
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)

# Extract all legend boxes
  legends <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == \guide-box\)]

# Save each legend manually (they're stacked in one box)
  legend_combined <- legends[[1]]  # Usually contains both

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\pDCM_MS_target_vs_others_legend.png\),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =2.15, height = 0.2)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = \none\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\all_genes_DCM_metagene.png\), p_nolegend,dpi=300,width = 3, height = 3)

library(\UCell\)

genes_list <- setNames(intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate$genes, intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate$cluster)
integrated_seurat <- AddModuleScore_UCell(integrated_seurat, 
                                      features=intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate, name=\UCell\)

integrated_seurat <- SmoothKNN(integrated_seurat, signature.names = paste0(names(intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate),\UCell\), reduction=\pca\)

FeaturePlot(integrated_seurat, reduction = \umap\, features = paste0(names(intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate),\UCell\))

FeaturePlot(integrated_seurat, reduction = \umap\, features = paste0(names(intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate),\UCell_kNN\))



output_dir <- \/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/Harber/Large_harber_plate_integration/AUC_moduleScore\

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)
library(FSA)   # for dunnTest()

# Define features

features2 <-  grep(\_kNN$\, colnames(integrated_seurat@meta.data), value = TRUE)

plots <- list()

# Desired cluster order
cluster_order <- c(\ISC\, \Enterocyte\, \Goblet\, \Paneth\, \Tuft\, \Enteroendocrine\)

for (feat in features2) {
  
  # Extract expression + metadata
  df <- FetchData(subset(integrated_seurat, Dataset2 %in% \pRNA\), vars = c(feat, \cell_identity_int2\))
  colnames(df) <- c(\expression\, \cluster\)
  
  # Ensure correct types
  df$expression <- as.numeric(df$expression)
  df$cluster <- factor(df$cluster, levels = cluster_order)
  
  # --- Kruskal-Wallis global test ---
  kw <- kruskal.test(expression ~ cluster, data = df)
  
  # --- Dunn’s test with BH correction ---
  dunn_res <- dunnTest(expression ~ cluster, data = df, method = \bh\)
  dunn_table <- dunn_res$res
  
  # Keep only significant comparisons
  dunn_table <- dunn_table %>%
    filter(P.adj < 0.05)
  
  if (nrow(dunn_table) > 0) {
    # Add significance stars
    dunn_table <- dunn_table %>%
      mutate(stars = case_when(
        P.adj < 1e-5  ~ \****\,
        P.adj < 1e-4  ~ \***\,
        P.adj < 1e-2  ~ \**\,
        P.adj < 0.05  ~ \*\
      ))
    
    # Add group1 / group2 columns
    dunn_table <- dunn_table %>%
      mutate(group1 = sapply(strsplit(Comparison, \ - \), `[`, 1),
             group2 = sapply(strsplit(Comparison, \ - \), `[`, 2),
             y.position = max(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE) * 
                          seq(1.05, 1.05 + 0.05*(nrow(.)-1), 0.05))
  }
  
  # --- Plot ---
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cluster, y = expression)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = cluster), trim = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, fill=\white\,colour=\black\) +
    #scale_fill_manual(values=publication_colors_27)+
    labs(
      title = paste0(feat, \\nKruskal–Wallis p=\, signif(kw$p.value, 3)),
      y = feat,
      x = \Cluster\
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = \none\
    )
  
  # Add only significant annotations
  if (nrow(dunn_table) > 0) {
    p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(
      dunn_table,
      label = \stars\,
      xmin = \group1\,
      xmax = \group2\,
      y.position = \y.position\,
      tip.length = 0.01
    )
  }
  
  plots[[feat]] <- p
}

compute_celltype_significance <- function(scores_df,
                                          suffix = \1\,
                                          method = c(\empirical\, \zscore\)) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  
  if (!\celltype\ %in% colnames(scores_df)) {
    stop(\scores_df must contain a column named 'celltype'\)
  }
  
  # Extract only score columns
  score_cols <- grep(paste0(suffix, \$\), colnames(scores_df), value = TRUE)
  scores <- as.matrix(scores_df[ , score_cols, drop = FALSE])
  celltypes <- scores_df$celltype
  
  n <- nrow(scores)
  pvals <- numeric(n)
  assigned_scores <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    ct <- celltypes[i]
    ct_col <- paste0(ct, suffix)
    if (!ct_col %in% colnames(scores)) {
      stop(paste(\Celltype\, ct, \not found among score columns\))
    }
    
    assigned_scores[i] <- scores[i, ct_col]
    others <- scores[i, setdiff(colnames(scores), ct_col)]
    
    if (method == \empirical\) {
      pvals[i] <- mean(others >= assigned_scores[i])
    } else if (method == \zscore\) {
      mu <- mean(others)
      sdv <- sd(others)
      if (sdv == 0) {
        pvals[i] <- 1
      } else {
        z <- (assigned_scores[i] - mu) / sdv
        pvals[i] <- 1 - pnorm(z)
      }
    }
  }
  
  fdr <- p.adjust(pvals, method = \BH\)
  
  out <- data.frame(
    celltype = celltypes,
    assigned_score = assigned_scores,
    pval = pvals,
    FDR = fdr,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  rownames(out) <- rownames(scores_df)
  return(out)
}

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
# (load other libraries as needed)

# 1. Compute per-cell sums and normalized proportions for marker gene sets
compute_marker_proportions <- function(seurat_obj,
                                       marker_list,
                                       assay = \RNA\,
                                       slot = \counts\,
                                       normalize = TRUE) {
  # marker_list: named list, names = cluster labels (e.g. \ClusterA\),
  # values = character vector of marker gene names (symbols must match rownames(seurat_obj))
  #
  # returns: data.frame rows=cells, cols = \<Cluster>_marker_prop\ (proportion per cell)
  
  if (!assay %in% names(seurat_obj@assays)) {
    stop(\Assay not found in Seurat object\)
  }
  mat <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = slot, assay = assay, as.sparse = TRUE)
  # mat is genes x cells (rows genes, cols cells)
  
  # total counts per cell (for proportion denominator)
  total_counts_per_cell <- Matrix::colSums(mat)
  total_counts_per_cell[total_counts_per_cell == 0] <- NA  # avoid division by zero later
  
  out <- matrix(0, nrow = ncol(mat), ncol = length(marker_list))
  colnames(out) <- paste0(names(marker_list), \_marker_prop\)
  rownames(out) <- colnames(mat)
  
  for (i in seq_along(marker_list)) {
    cluster_name <- names(marker_list)[i]
    genes <- unique(marker_list[[i]])
    genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(mat))
    n_genes_present <- length(genes_present)
    if (n_genes_present == 0) {
      warning(sprintf(\No marker genes of cluster '%s' found in assay rows; filling 0s\, cluster_name))
      next
    }
    # sum counts for those genes per cell
    sum_set_counts <- Matrix::colSums(mat[genes_present, , drop = FALSE])
    # normalize by number of genes present (so gene-set size differences are accounted)
    if (normalize) {
      norm_sum <- sum_set_counts / n_genes_present
    } else {
      norm_sum <- sum_set_counts
    }
    # proportion of total counts going to this (size-normalized) gene set
    prop <- norm_sum / total_counts_per_cell
    # replace NA (cells with zero total) with 0
    prop[is.na(prop)] <- 0
    out[, i] <- prop
  }
  
  return(as.data.frame(out))
}


# 2. Significance test using the assigned celltype (assumes column 'celltype' provided)
#    Uses either 'empirical' (fraction of other gene-set props >= assigned prop),
#    'zscore' (z vs others), or 'rank' (rank-based)
compute_celltype_prop_significance <- function(prop_df,           # dataframe from compute_marker_proportions
                                               celltype_vec,      # character vector per cell with assigned celltype (exact cluster names)
                                               suffix = \_marker_prop\,
                                               method = c(\empirical\, \zscore\, \rank\),
                                               adjust_within = c(\global\, \by_celltype\)) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  adjust_within <- match.arg(adjust_within)
  if (length(celltype_vec) != nrow(prop_df)) stop(\celltype_vec length must match rows of prop_df\)
  
  # Only keep columns ending with suffix
  score_cols <- grep(paste0(suffix, \$\), colnames(prop_df), value = TRUE)
  scores <- as.matrix(prop_df[, score_cols, drop = FALSE])  # cells x gene-sets
  celltypes <- celltype_vec
  n <- nrow(scores)
  pvals <- numeric(n)
  assigned_scores <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    ct <- celltypes[i]
    ct_col <- paste0(ct, suffix)
    if (!ct_col %in% colnames(scores)) {
      warning(sprintf(\cell %s: assigned celltype '%s' not present among score columns. pval set to NA\, rownames(prop_df)[i], ct))
      pvals[i] <- NA
      assigned_scores[i] <- NA
      next
    }
    assigned_scores[i] <- scores[i, ct_col]
    others <- scores[i, setdiff(colnames(scores), ct_col)]
    
    if (method == \empirical\) {
      # fraction of other gene-set props >= assigned -> small if assigned is bigger than almost all others
      pvals[i] <- mean(others >= assigned_scores[i])
    } else if (method == \zscore\) {
      mu <- mean(others)
      sdv <- sd(others)
      if (is.na(sdv) || sdv == 0) {
        pvals[i] <- 1
      } else {
        z <- (assigned_scores[i] - mu) / sdv
        pvals[i] <- 1 - pnorm(z)   # one-sided: prob that a normal var > observed z
      }
    } else if (method == \rank\) {
      # rank among all values in this cell (higher = better)
      # smaller p = higher rank (rank/numSets)
      rnk <- rank(-c(scores[i, ]))[which(colnames(scores) == ct_col)]
      pvals[i] <- rnk / ncol(scores)
    }
  }
  
  # Adjust p-values for multiple testing:
  if (adjust_within == \global\) {
    FDR <- p.adjust(pvals, method = \BH\)
  } else {
    # adjust p-values within each celltype separately
    FDR <- numeric(length(pvals))
    FDR[] <- NA
    for (ct in unique(celltypes)) {
      idx <- which(celltypes == ct & !is.na(pvals))
      if (length(idx) > 0) {
        FDR[idx] <- p.adjust(pvals[idx], method = \BH\)
      }
    }
  }
  
  out <- data.frame(
    assigned_celltype = celltypes,
    assigned_prop = assigned_scores,
    pval = pvals,
    FDR = FDR,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  rownames(out) <- rownames(prop_df)
  return(out)
}


# 3. Convenience wrapper: compute props from Seurat object, test, and merge into seurat@meta.data
compute_and_store_marker_significance <- function(seurat_obj,
                                                  marker_list,
                                                  celltype_meta = \cell_identity_int2\,   # metadata column with assigned type
                                                  assay = \RNA\,
                                                  slot = \counts\,
                                                  suffix = \_marker_prop\,
                                                  method = \rank\,
                                                  adjust_within = \by_celltype\,
                                                  normalize_gene_set = TRUE,
                                                  meta_prefix = \marker_\) {
  # compute proportions
  props <- compute_marker_proportions(seurat_obj, marker_list, assay = assay, slot = slot,
                                     normalize = normalize_gene_set)
  # ensure rownames match cellnames
  # run test
  celltype_vec <- seurat_obj@meta.data[[celltype_meta]]
  names(celltype_vec) <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
  res <- compute_celltype_prop_significance(props, celltype_vec, suffix = suffix,
                                            method = method, adjust_within = adjust_within)
  # merge into metadata
  # prefix column names so they don't collide
  md <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, \assigned_prop\)]] <- res$assigned_prop[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, \pval\)]] <- res$pval[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, \FDR\)]] <- res$FDR[rownames(md)]
  seurat_obj@meta.data <- md
  return(list(seurat = seurat_obj, props = props, test_res = res))
}

##Denominator total counts of gene sets

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)

# 1. Compute per-cell proportions relative to total marker counts
compute_marker_proportions_relative <- function(seurat_obj,
                                                marker_list,
                                                assay = \RNA\,
                                                slot = \counts\,
                                                normalize = TRUE) {
  mat <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = slot, assay = assay, as.sparse = TRUE)
  
  out_raw <- matrix(0, nrow = ncol(mat), ncol = length(marker_list))
  colnames(out_raw) <- paste0(names(marker_list), \_marker_prop\)
  rownames(out_raw) <- colnames(mat)
  
  for (i in seq_along(marker_list)) {
    cluster_name <- names(marker_list)[i]
    genes <- unique(marker_list[[i]])
    genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(mat))
    n_genes_present <- length(genes_present)
    if (n_genes_present == 0) {
      warning(sprintf(\No marker genes of cluster '%s' found; filling 0s\, cluster_name))
      next
    }
    sum_set_counts <- Matrix::colSums(mat[genes_present, , drop = FALSE])
    if (normalize) {
      sum_set_counts <- sum_set_counts / n_genes_present
    }
    out_raw[, i] <- sum_set_counts
  }
  
  # Normalize so proportions sum to 1 across all sets (per cell)
  row_sums <- rowSums(out_raw)
  row_sums[row_sums == 0] <- NA
  out <- sweep(out_raw, 1, row_sums, \/\)
  out[is.na(out)] <- 0
  
  return(as.data.frame(out))
}

# 2. Significance test: is assigned celltype’s proportion higher than others?
compute_celltype_prop_significance <- function(prop_df,
                                               celltype_vec,
                                               suffix = \_marker_prop\,
                                               method = c(\empirical\, \zscore\, \rank\),
                                               adjust_within = c(\global\, \by_celltype\)) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  adjust_within <- match.arg(adjust_within)
  
  score_cols <- grep(paste0(suffix, \$\), colnames(prop_df), value = TRUE)
  scores <- as.matrix(prop_df[, score_cols, drop = FALSE])
  celltypes <- celltype_vec
  
  n <- nrow(scores)
  pvals <- numeric(n)
  assigned_scores <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    ct <- celltypes[i]
    ct_col <- paste0(ct, suffix)
    if (!ct_col %in% colnames(scores)) {
      pvals[i] <- NA
      assigned_scores[i] <- NA
      next
    }
    assigned_scores[i] <- scores[i, ct_col]
    others <- scores[i, setdiff(colnames(scores), ct_col)]
    
    if (method == \empirical\) {
      pvals[i] <- mean(others >= assigned_scores[i])
    } else if (method == \zscore\) {
      mu <- mean(others)
      sdv <- sd(others)
      if (sdv == 0) {
        pvals[i] <- 1
      } else {
        z <- (assigned_scores[i] - mu) / sdv
        pvals[i] <- 1 - pnorm(z)
      }
    } else if (method == \rank\) {
      rnk <- rank(-c(scores[i, ]))[which(colnames(scores) == ct_col)]
      pvals[i] <- rnk / ncol(scores)
    }
  }
  
  if (adjust_within == \global\) {
    FDR <- p.adjust(pvals, method = \BH\)
  } else {
    FDR <- rep(NA, length(pvals))
    for (ct in unique(celltypes)) {
      idx <- which(celltypes == ct & !is.na(pvals))
      if (length(idx) > 0) {
        FDR[idx] <- p.adjust(pvals[idx], method = \BH\)
      }
    }
  }
  
  out <- data.frame(
    assigned_celltype = celltypes,
    assigned_prop = assigned_scores,
    pval = pvals,
    FDR = FDR,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  rownames(out) <- rownames(prop_df)
  return(out)
}

# 3. Wrapper: compute + test + store into Seurat object
compute_and_store_marker_significance <- function(seurat_obj,
                                                  marker_list,
                                                  celltype_meta = \cell_identity_int2\,
                                                  assay = \RNA\,
                                                  slot = \counts\,
                                                  suffix = \_marker_prop\,
                                                  method = \rank\,
                                                  adjust_within = \by_celltype\,
                                                  normalize_gene_set = TRUE,
                                                  meta_prefix = \marker_\) {
  props <- compute_marker_proportions_relative(
    seurat_obj, marker_list,
    assay = assay, slot = slot,
    normalize = normalize_gene_set
  )
  
  celltype_vec <- seurat_obj@meta.data[[celltype_meta]]
  names(celltype_vec) <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
  
  res <- compute_celltype_prop_significance(
    props, celltype_vec,
    suffix = suffix,
    method = method,
    adjust_within = adjust_within
  )
  
  md <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, \assigned_prop\)]] <- res$assigned_prop[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, \pval\)]] <- res$pval[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, \FDR\)]] <- res$FDR[rownames(md)]
  seurat_obj@meta.data <- md
  
  return(list(seurat = seurat_obj, props = props, test_res = res))
}

# 4. Heatmap of per-celltype significance proportions
plot_signif_heatmap <- function(test_res, alpha = 0.05, plot_title = NULL) {
  df <- test_res %>%
    mutate(significant = ifelse(!is.na(FDR) & FDR < alpha, 1, 0)) %>%
    group_by(assigned_celltype) %>%
    summarise(total_cells = n(),
              significant_cells = sum(significant),
              prop_significant = significant_cells / total_cells,
              .groups = \drop\)
  
  mat <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(assigned_celltype, prop_significant) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames(\assigned_celltype\) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # fix case where all values are identical
  if (length(unique(as.vector(mat))) == 1) {
    mat <- mat + rnorm(length(mat), mean = 0, sd = 1e-6)
  }
  
  if (is.null(plot_title)) {
    plot_title <- sprintf(\Proportion of significant cells (FDR < %.3f)\, alpha)
  }
  
  pheatmap(mat, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
           main = plot_title, color = colorRampPalette(c(\white\, \red\))(100))
  
  return(df)
}

######proportions celltype

group_level_test <- function(props, celltype_vec, suffix = \_marker_prop\, threshold = NULL) {
  if (nrow(props) != length(celltype_vec)) stop(\props rows must match length of celltype_vec\)
  score_cols <- grep(paste0(suffix, \$\), colnames(props), value = TRUE)
  if (length(score_cols) == 0) stop(\No score columns found with that suffix\)

  # number of gene sets
  k <- length(score_cols)
  if (is.null(threshold)) threshold <- 1 / k

  unique_ct <- sort(unique(celltype_vec))

  results <- tibble::tibble(
    celltype = character(0),
    n_cells = integer(0),
    mean_prop_assigned = numeric(0),
    median_prop_assigned = numeric(0),
    prop_above_threshold = numeric(0),
    wilcox_p = numeric(0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (ct in unique_ct) {
    ct_col <- paste0(ct, suffix)
    if (!ct_col %in% colnames(props)) {
      warning(sprintf(\Skipping %s: no column %s in props\, ct, ct_col))
      next
    }

    idx_assigned <- which(celltype_vec == ct)
    idx_other <- which(celltype_vec != ct)

    # the proportions for this gene-set in assigned cells vs others
    vals_assigned <- props[idx_assigned, ct_col]
    vals_other    <- props[idx_other, ct_col]

    # descriptive stats
    mean_p <- mean(vals_assigned, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_p  <- median(vals_assigned, na.rm = TRUE)
    prop_above <- mean(vals_assigned > threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

    # wilcoxon one-sided: assigned > other
    # require at least one non-NA in each group and enough data
    wilcox_p <- NA
    if (length(na.omit(vals_assigned)) >= 3 && length(na.omit(vals_other)) >= 3) {
      wt <- wilcox.test(vals_assigned, vals_other, alternative = \greater\, exact = FALSE)
      wilcox_p <- wt$p.value
    } else {
      # fallback: if small groups, do a simple Mann-Whitney with exact if possible:
      try({
        wt <- wilcox.test(vals_assigned, vals_other, alternative = \greater\)
        wilcox_p <- wt$p.value
      }, silent = TRUE)
    }

    results <- results %>% add_row(
      celltype = ct,
      n_cells = length(idx_assigned),
      mean_prop_assigned = mean_p,
      median_prop_assigned = med_p,
      prop_above_threshold = prop_above,
      wilcox_p = wilcox_p
    )
  }

  # FDR correction across celltypes
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(wilcox_p = as.numeric(wilcox_p)) %>%
    arrange(celltype) %>%
    mutate(wilcox_FDR = p.adjust(wilcox_p, method = \BH\))

  # Plotting helpers
  # 1) barplot: mean proportion per celltype (with proportion above threshold overlay)
  p_bar <- ggplot(results, aes(x = reorder(celltype, -mean_prop_assigned), y = mean_prop_assigned)) +
    geom_col(fill = \steelblue\) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf(\%.1f%%\, 100 * prop_above_threshold)),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
    labs(x = \Celltype\, y = \Mean assigned proportion\, title = \Mean assigned proportion per celltype\n(text = % cells > threshold)\) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  # 2) heatmap: matrix of mean proportions per gene-set (rows) vs celltypes (columns)
  # Build matrix of means: for each gene-set column (CT_marker_prop), compute mean across cells assigned to each CT
  mean_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(score_cols), ncol = length(unique_ct),
                     dimnames = list(score_cols, unique_ct))
  for (ct in unique_ct) {
    idx_assigned <- which(celltype_vec == ct)
    mean_mat[, ct] <- colMeans(props[idx_assigned, score_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # small fix if all values identical
  if (length(unique(as.vector(mean_mat))) == 1) mean_mat <- mean_mat + rnorm(length(mean_mat), 0, 1e-8)

  p_heat <- pheatmap::pheatmap(mean_mat,
                               cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
                               main = sprintf(\Mean gene-set proportion (by assigned celltype)\n(threshold = %.3f)\, threshold),
                               silent = TRUE)

  return(list(summary = results, barplot = p_bar, heatmap = p_heat))
}

##Proportions sig per cell

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)

# 1) Compute raw counts per cell per marker set (and optional size-normalized sums)
compute_marker_set_counts <- function(seurat_obj,
                                      marker_list,
                                      assay = \RNA\,
                                      slot = \counts\,
                                      normalize_by_gene_count = FALSE) {
  # Returns a data.frame (rows=cells) with columns \<Cluster>_set_counts\ (raw sums)
  if (!assay %in% names(seurat_obj@assays)) {
    stop(\Assay not found in Seurat object\)
  }
  mat <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = slot, assay = assay, as.sparse = TRUE)
  out_raw <- matrix(0, nrow = ncol(mat), ncol = length(marker_list))
  colnames(out_raw) <- paste0(names(marker_list), \_set_counts\)
  rownames(out_raw) <- colnames(mat)
  
  for (i in seq_along(marker_list)) {
    cluster_name <- names(marker_list)[i]
    genes <- unique(marker_list[[i]])
    genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(mat))
    n_genes_present <- length(genes_present)
    if (n_genes_present == 0) {
      warning(sprintf(\No marker genes for '%s' found; filling 0s\, cluster_name))
      next
    }
    sum_set_counts <- Matrix::colSums(mat[genes_present, , drop = FALSE])
    if (normalize_by_gene_count) {
      sum_set_counts <- sum_set_counts / n_genes_present
    }
    out_raw[, i] <- as.numeric(sum_set_counts)
  }
  as.data.frame(out_raw)
}

# 2) Per-cell binomial test function
#    - prop0 = 1/k by default
#    - min_marker_counts: minimum total marker-set counts (trials) to attempt test; otherwise pval = NA
#    - adjust_within: \global\ or \by_celltype\
compute_per_cell_binom_significance <- function(counts_df,          # output of compute_marker_set_counts
                                                celltype_vec,       # vector of assigned celltypes, length = nrow(counts_df)
                                                suffix = \_set_counts\,
                                                prop0 = NULL,       # if NULL, set to 1/k automatically
                                                min_marker_counts = 10,
                                                adjust_within = c(\global\, \by_celltype\)) {
  adjust_within <- match.arg(adjust_within)
  score_cols <- grep(paste0(suffix, \$\), colnames(counts_df), value = TRUE)
  if (length(score_cols) == 0) stop(\No marker set count columns found with given suffix.\)
  k <- length(score_cols)
  if (is.null(prop0)) prop0 <- 1 / k
  
  scores <- as.matrix(counts_df[, score_cols, drop = FALSE])
  n <- nrow(scores)
  pvals <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  assigned_counts <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  total_marker_counts <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    ct <- celltype_vec[i]
    ct_col <- paste0(ct, suffix)
    if (!ct_col %in% colnames(scores)) {
      # assigned cluster not found among columns -> set NA
      next
    }
    assigned_counts[i] <- scores[i, ct_col]
    total_marker_counts[i] <- sum(scores[i, ], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(total_marker_counts[i]) || total_marker_counts[i] < min_marker_counts) {
      pvals[i] <- NA
      next
    }
    # Binomial test: successes = assigned_counts, trials = total_marker_counts
    # H0: p = prop0 ; HA: p > prop0
    # use binom.test (exact, one-sided)
    bt <- binom.test(x = assigned_counts[i],
                     n = total_marker_counts[i],
                     p = prop0,
                     alternative = \greater\)
    pvals[i] <- bt$p.value
  }
  
  # Multiple testing correction
  FDR <- rep(NA_real_, length(pvals))
  if (adjust_within == \global\) {
    # adjust across all non-NA pvals
    idx <- which(!is.na(pvals))
    if (length(idx) > 0) FDR[idx] <- p.adjust(pvals[idx], method = \BH\)
  } else {
    # adjust separately within each celltype
    for (ct in unique(celltype_vec)) {
      idx_ct <- which(celltype_vec == ct & !is.na(pvals))
      if (length(idx_ct) > 0) {
        FDR[idx_ct] <- p.adjust(pvals[idx_ct], method = \BH\)
      }
    }
  }
  
  out <- data.frame(
    assigned_counts = assigned_counts,
    total_marker_counts = total_marker_counts,
    pval = pvals,
    FDR = FDR,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  rownames(out) <- rownames(counts_df)
  return(out)
}

# 3) Wrapper that computes counts, runs binom test, merges into seurat metadata
compute_and_store_binom_marker_significance <- function(seurat_obj,
                                                       marker_list,
                                                       celltype_meta = \cell_identity_int2\,
                                                       assay = \RNA\,
                                                       slot = \counts\,
                                                       normalize_by_gene_count = FALSE,
                                                       min_marker_counts = 10,
                                                       adjust_within = \by_celltype\,
                                                       meta_prefix = \binom_marker_\) {
  counts_df <- compute_marker_set_counts(seurat_obj, marker_list,
                                         assay = assay, slot = slot,
                                         normalize_by_gene_count = normalize_by_gene_count)
  celltype_vec <- seurat_obj@meta.data[[celltype_meta]]
  if (length(celltype_vec) != nrow(counts_df)) stop(\celltype vector length mismatch\)
  names(celltype_vec) <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
  
  test_res <- compute_per_cell_binom_significance(counts_df, celltype_vec,
                                                  suffix = \_set_counts\,
                                                  prop0 = NULL,
                                                  min_marker_counts = min_marker_counts,
                                                  adjust_within = adjust_within)
  # merge into metadata
  md <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, \assigned_counts\)]] <- test_res$assigned_counts[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, \total_marker_counts\)]] <- test_res$total_marker_counts[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, \pval\)]] <- test_res$pval[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, \FDR\)]] <- test_res$FDR[rownames(md)]
  seurat_obj@meta.data <- md
  
  return(list(seurat = seurat_obj, counts = counts_df, test_res = test_res))
}


res_binom <- compute_and_store_binom_marker_significance(

  celltype_meta = \cell_identity_int2\,

  min_marker_counts = 10,           # skip tests for cells with <10 marker counts
  adjust_within = \by_celltype\,    # adjust FDR within each celltype (less harsh)
  meta_prefix = \binom_marker_\
)

```r
top_overlap_genes <- lapply(gene_sets_per_cluster, function(genes) {
  intersect_genes <- intersect(genes$pRNA, genes$pDCM)
  head(intersect_genes, 10)
})
all_top_genes <- unique(unlist(top_overlap_genes))

integrated_seurat$cell_identity_int2 <- factor(integrated_seurat$cell_identity_int2, levels = c(\ISC\,\Enterocyte\,\Goblet\,\Paneth\,\Tuft\,\Enteroendocrine\))

p <- DotPlot(subset(integrated_seurat, Dataset == \pRNA\), 
        features = all_top_genes, 
        group.by = \cell_identity_int2\,
        scale.by = \size\,
        assay = \RNA\,
        dot.scale = 10,
        scale = T) +
    RotatedAxis() + 
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = c( \white\,\lightblue\, \darkred\))+
  #scale_colour_gradientn(colours = rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = \RdBu\)))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  ggtitle(\Top 10 Overlapping Marker Genes in pRNA\)+
 theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5, color=\black\),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, face = \plain\, hjust = 1, color=\black\),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),  # <- removes the tick lines you mentioned
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = \right\,
      legend.box = \vertical\,
      legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.2, \cm\)
    )+    guides(fill= guide_legend(ncol = 1))

  # Save the plot
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)

# Extract all legend boxes
  legends <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == \guide-box\)]

# Save each legend manually (they're stacked in one box)
  legend_combined <- legends[[1]]  # Usually contains both

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\dotplot_marker_genes_pRNA_legend.png\),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width = 0.75, height = 2)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = \none\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\dotplot_marker_genes_pRNA.pdf\), p,dpi=300, width = 9, height = 3)


p <- DotPlot(subset(integrated_seurat, Dataset == \pDCM\), 
        features = all_top_genes, 
        group.by = \cell_identity_int2\,
        assay = \RNA\,
       scale.by = \size\,
        dot.scale = 10,
        scale = T) +
  RotatedAxis() + 
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = c( \white\,\lightblue\, \darkred\))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  ggtitle(\Top 10 Overlapping Marker Genes in pDCM\)+
   theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5, color=\black\),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, face = \plain\, hjust = 1, color=\black\),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),  # <- removes the tick lines you mentioned
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = \right\,
      legend.box = \vertical\,
      legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.2, \cm\)
    )+    guides(fill= guide_legend(ncol = 1))

  # Save the plot
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)

# Extract all legend boxes
  legends <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == \guide-box\)]

# Save each legend manually (they're stacked in one box)
  legend_combined <- legends[[1]]  # Usually contains both

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\dotplot_marker_genes_pDCM_legend.png\),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width = 0.75, height = 2)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = \none\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\dotplot_marker_genes_pDCM.png\), p_nolegend,dpi=300, width = 9, height = 3)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\dotplot_marker_genes_pDCM.pdf\), p,dpi=300, width = 9, height = 3)

int_meta <- integrated_seurat@meta.data
int_meta_DCM <- int_meta[int_meta$Dataset == \pDCM\,]
int_meta_RNA <- int_meta[int_meta$Dataset == \pRNA\,]
int_meta_DCM2 <- int_meta_DCM[match(int_meta_RNA$Sample_RNA, int_meta_DCM$Sample_RNA),]
int_meta_DCM2$Sample_RNA == int_meta_RNA$Sample_RNA
int_meta_DCM2$cell_identity_int2_RNA <- int_meta_RNA$cell_identity_int2
int_meta_DCM2$Tuft1_RNA <- int_meta_RNA$Tuft1
int_meta_DCM2$Goblet1_RNA <- int_meta_RNA$Goblet1
int_meta_DCM2$ISC1_RNA <- int_meta_RNA$ISC1
int_meta_DCM2$Enteroendocrine1_RNA <- int_meta_RNA$Enteroendocrine1
int_meta_DCM2$Enterocyte1_RNA <- int_meta_RNA$Enterocyte1
int_meta_DCM2$Paneth1_RNA <- int_meta_RNA$Paneth1
int_meta_DCM2$nCount_RNA_RNA <- int_meta_RNA$nCount_RNA

int_meta_DCM2 <- int_meta_DCM2[!grepl(\^NA\,rownames(int_meta_DCM2)), ]
int_meta_DCM2$transition <- paste0(int_meta_DCM2$cell_identity_int2,\_to_\,int_meta_DCM2$cell_identity_int2_RNA)

transition_cells_goblet_tuft <- subset(int_meta_DCM2, transition %in% c(
  \Tuft_to_Goblet\, 
  \Tuft_to_Tuft\, 
  \Goblet_to_Tuft\, 
  \Goblet_to_Goblet\
))

transition_order_goblet_tuft <- c(
  \Tuft_to_Tuft\,
  \Tuft_to_Goblet\,
  \Goblet_to_Tuft\,
  \Goblet_to_Goblet\
)

transition_cells_goblet_tuft <- transition_cells_goblet_tuft %>%
  mutate(transition = factor(transition, levels = transition_order_goblet_tuft)) %>%
  arrange(transition)  # Sort rows by transition

# Create a matrix (rows = cells, columns = Tuft1/Goblet1)
heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft <- transition_cells_goblet_tuft %>%
  select(Tuft1, Goblet1) %>%  # Select score columns
  t()                        # Transpose to genes x cells

# Add cell IDs as column names
colnames(heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft) <- transition_cells_goblet_tuft$Sample_RNA  # Replace 'cell_id' with your actual column name

# Annotation for transitions (column-wise)
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Transition = transition_cells_goblet_tuft$transition,
  row.names = transition_cells_goblet_tuft$Sample_RNA
)

# Plot

heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft_t <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft)))
Depth_DCM_goblet_Tuft <- data.frame(row.names = transition_cells_goblet_tuft$Sample_RNA,
                                   Depth= transition_cells_goblet_tuft$nCount_RNA)
Depth_DCM_goblet_Tuft <- t(Depth_DCM_goblet_Tuft)

z_min <- min(heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft_t, na.rm = TRUE)
z_max <- max(heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft_t, na.rm = TRUE)
library(plyr)
legend_min <- round_any(z_min, 0.5, floor)        # or: round_any(z_min, 0.5, floor)
legend_max <- round_any(z_max, 0.5, ceiling) 

png(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_Tuft_Goblet_DCM_MS_30042025.png\), width = 6, height = 1.75, units = \in\, res=300)  # Adjust width/height as needed
svg(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_Tuft_Goblet_DCM_MS_30042025.svg\), width = 6, height = 1.75)  # Adjust width/height as needed
pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft_t,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = FALSE,  # Hide cell IDs
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_goblet_tuft$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  #scale = \column\,
  #legend=FALSE,
  annotation_legend = FALSE,
  cellheight = 12,
  annotation_colors = list(
    Transition = c(
      Tuft_to_Tuft = \darkgreen\,
      Tuft_to_Goblet = \purple\,
      Goblet_to_Tuft = \orange\,
      Goblet_to_Goblet = \steelblue\
    )
  ),
 # scale=\column\,
  main = \Tuft vs. Goblet Module Scores DCM\,
   fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300)
 #legend_breaks = c(legend_min, legend_max),  # ONLY show min and max
 #legend_labels = c(as.character(legend_min), as.character(legend_max))  # Format to 2 decimals# Bottom/right margins (increase if elements are cut off)
)
dev.off()


svg(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_Tuft_Goblet_DCM_MS_depth_30042025.svg\), width = 6, height = 2)  # Adjust width/height as needed
pheatmap(
  Depth_DCM_goblet_Tuft,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = TRUE,  # Hide cell IDs
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_goblet_tuft$transition)), # Add gaps between transition groups
  #scale = \column\,
  annotation_legend = FALSE,
  annotation_colors = list(
    Transition = c(
      Tuft_to_Tuft = \darkgreen\,
      Tuft_to_Goblet = \purple\,
      Goblet_to_Tuft = \orange\,
      Goblet_to_Goblet = \steelblue\
    )
  ),
  main = \Tuft vs. Goblet Module Scores DCM\
)


dev.off()



transition_cells_goblet_tuft <- transition_cells_goblet_tuft %>%
  mutate(transition = factor(transition, levels = transition_order_goblet_tuft)) %>%
  arrange(transition)  # Sort rows by transition

# Create a matrix (rows = cells, columns = Tuft1/Goblet1)

z_max <- max(heatmap_data_RNA_tuftgoblet_t, na.rm = TRUE)

 # Adjust width/height as needed

)

transition_cells_goblet_tuft <- subset(int_meta_DCM2, transition %in% c(
  \Tuft_to_Goblet\, 
  \Tuft_to_Tuft\, 
  \Goblet_to_Tuft\, 
  \Goblet_to_Goblet\
))

transition_order_goblet_tuft <- c(
  \Tuft_to_Tuft\,
  \Tuft_to_Goblet\,
  \Goblet_to_Tuft\,
  \Goblet_to_Goblet\
)

transition_cells_goblet_tuft <- transition_cells_goblet_tuft %>%
  mutate(transition = factor(transition, levels = transition_order_goblet_tuft)) %>%
  arrange(transition)  # Sort rows by transition

# Create a matrix (rows = cells, columns = Tuft1/Goblet1)
heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft_5MS <- transition_cells_goblet_tuft %>%
  select(Tuft1, Goblet1, Enteroendocrine1, Enterocyte1) %>%  # Select score columns
  t()                        # Transpose to genes x cells

# Add cell IDs as column names
colnames(heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft_5MS) <- transition_cells_goblet_tuft$Sample_RNA  # Replace 'cell_id' with your actual column name

# Annotation for transitions (column-wise)
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Transition = transition_cells_goblet_tuft$transition,
  row.names = transition_cells_goblet_tuft$Sample_RNA
)

# Plot

heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft_5MS_t <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft_5MS)))


png(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_Tuft_Goblet_DCM_MS_30042025.png\), width = 6, height = 1.75, units = \in\, res=300)  # Adjust width/height as needed
svg(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_Tuft_Goblet_DCM_5MS_30042025.svg\), width = 6, height = 1.75)  # Adjust width/height as needed
pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_DCM_goblte_tuft_5MS_t,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = FALSE,  # Hide cell IDs
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_goblet_tuft$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  scale = \column\,
  #legend=FALSE,
  annotation_legend = FALSE,
  cellheight = 12,
  annotation_colors = list(
    Transition = c(
      Tuft_to_Tuft = \darkgreen\,
      Tuft_to_Goblet = \purple\,
      Goblet_to_Tuft = \orange\,
      Goblet_to_Goblet = \steelblue\
    )
  ),
 # scale=\column\,
  main = \Tuft vs. Goblet Module Scores DCM\,
   fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300)
 #legend_breaks = c(legend_min, legend_max),  # ONLY show min and max
 #legend_labels = c(as.character(legend_min), as.character(legend_max))  # Format to 2 decimals# Bottom/right margins (increase if elements are cut off)
)
dev.off()



transition_cells_goblet_tuft <- transition_cells_goblet_tuft %>%
  mutate(transition = factor(transition, levels = transition_order_goblet_tuft)) %>%
  arrange(transition)  # Sort rows by transition

# Create a matrix (rows = cells, columns = Tuft1/Goblet1)
heatmap_data_RNA_tuftgoblet_5 <- transition_cells_goblet_tuft %>%
  select(Tuft1_RNA, Goblet1_RNA, Enteroendocrine1_RNA, Enterocyte1_RNA) %>%  # Select score columns
  t()                        # Transpose to genes x cells

```r
transition_cells_paneth_tuft_goblet <- subset(int_meta_DCM2, transition %in% c(
  \Paneth_to_Paneth\, 
  \Paneth_to_Tuft\, 
  \Paneth_to_Goblet\
))

transition_order_paneth_tuft_goblet <- c(
  \Paneth_to_Paneth\, 
  \Paneth_to_Tuft\, 
  \Paneth_to_Goblet\
)

transition_cells_paneth_tuft_goblet <- transition_cells_paneth_tuft_goblet %>%
  mutate(transition = factor(transition, levels = transition_order_paneth_tuft_goblet)) %>%
  arrange(transition)  # Sort rows by transition

# Create a matrix (rows = cells, columns = Tuft1/Goblet1)
heatmap_data_DCM_paneth_tuft_goblet <- transition_cells_paneth_tuft_goblet %>%
  select(Paneth1,Tuft1, Goblet1) %>%  # Select score columns
  t()                        # Transpose to genes x cells

# Add cell IDs as column names
colnames(heatmap_data_DCM_paneth_tuft_goblet) <- transition_cells_paneth_tuft_goblet$Sample_RNA  # Replace 'cell_id' with your actual column name

# Annotation for transitions (column-wise)
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Transition = transition_cells_paneth_tuft_goblet$transition,
  row.names = transition_cells_paneth_tuft_goblet$Sample_RNA
)

# Plot

heatmap_data_DCM_paneth_tuft_goblet_t <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data_DCM_paneth_tuft_goblet)))
Depth_DCM_paneth_tuft_goblet <- data.frame(row.names = transition_cells_paneth_tuft_goblet$Sample_RNA,
                                   Depth= transition_cells_paneth_tuft_goblet$nCount_RNA)
Depth_DCM_paneth_tuft_goblet <- t(Depth_DCM_paneth_tuft_goblet)

z_min <- min(heatmap_data_DCM_paneth_tuft_goblet_t, na.rm = TRUE)
z_max <- max(heatmap_data_DCM_paneth_tuft_goblet_t, na.rm = TRUE)
library(plyr)
legend_min <- round_any(z_min, 0.5, floor)        # or: round_any(z_min, 0.5, floor)
legend_max <- round_any(z_max, 0.5, ceiling) 

png(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_Tuft_Goblet_DCM_MS_30042025.png\), width = 6, height = 1.75, units = \in\, res=300)  # Adjust width/height as needed
svg(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_paneth_Tuft_Goblet_DCM_MS_30042025.svg\), width = 6, height = 1.75)  # Adjust width/height as needed
pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_DCM_paneth_tuft_goblet_t,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = FALSE,  # Hide cell IDs
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_paneth_tuft_goblet$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  scale = \column\,
  #legend=FALSE,

transition_cells_entero_secretory <- subset(int_meta_DCM2, transition %in% c(
  \Enterocyte_to_Enterocyte\, 
  \Enterocyte_to_Paneth\, 
  \Paneth_to_Enterocyte\,
  \Goblet_to_Enterocyte\,
  \Tuft_to_Enterocyte\,
  \Enteroendocrine_to_Enterocyte\
))

transition_order_entero_secretory <- c(
  \Enterocyte_to_Enterocyte\, 
  \Enterocyte_to_Paneth\, 
  \Paneth_to_Enterocyte\,
  \Goblet_to_Enterocyte\,
  \Tuft_to_Enterocyte\,
  \Enteroendocrine_to_Enterocyte\
)

transition_cells_entero_secretory <- transition_cells_entero_secretory %>%
  mutate(transition = factor(transition, levels = transition_order_entero_secretory)) %>%
  arrange(transition)  # Sort rows by transition

# Create a matrix (rows = cells, columns = Tuft1/Goblet1)
heatmap_data_DCM_entero_secretory<- transition_cells_entero_secretory %>%
  select(Enterocyte1,Paneth1,Tuft1, Goblet1,Enteroendocrine1) %>%  # Select score columns
  t()                        # Transpose to genes x cells

# Add cell IDs as column names
colnames(heatmap_data_DCM_entero_secretory) <- transition_cells_entero_secretory$Sample_RNA  # Replace 'cell_id' with your actual column name

# Annotation for transitions (column-wise)
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Transition = transition_cells_entero_secretory$transition,
  row.names = transition_cells_entero_secretory$Sample_RNA
)

# Plot

heatmap_data_DCM_entero_secretory_t <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data_DCM_entero_secretory)))
Depth_DCM_entero_secretory <- data.frame(row.names = transition_cells_entero_secretory$Sample_RNA,
                                   Depth= transition_cells_entero_secretory$nCount_RNA)
Depth_DCM_entero_secretory <- t(Depth_DCM_entero_secretory)

z_min <- min(heatmap_data_DCM_entero_secretory_t, na.rm = TRUE)
z_max <- max(heatmap_data_DCM_entero_secretory_t, na.rm = TRUE)
library(plyr)
legend_min <- round_any(z_min, 0.5, floor)        # or: round_any(z_min, 0.5, floor)
legend_max <- round_any(z_max, 0.5, ceiling) 


svg(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_entero_secretory_DCM_MS_30042025.svg\), width = 6, height = 1.75)  # Adjust width/height as needed
pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_DCM_entero_secretory_t,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = FALSE,  # Hide cell IDs
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_entero_secretory$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  #scale = \column\,
  #legend=FALSE,
  annotation_legend = FALSE,
  cellheight = 12,
  annotation_colors = list(
    Transition = c(
      Enterocyte_to_Enterocyte = \darkgreen\,
      Enterocyte_to_Paneth = \purple\,
      Paneth_to_Enterocyte = \steelblue\,
      Goblet_to_Enterocyte = \#FFFF99\,
      Tuft_to_Enterocyte = \#B15928\,
      Enteroendocrine_to_Enterocyte = \#8DD3C7\
    )
  ),
 # scale=\column\,
  main = \Absorptive vs. Secretory Module Scores DCM\,
   fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300)
 #legend_breaks = c(legend_min, legend_max),  # ONLY show min and max
 #legend_labels = c(as.character(legend_min), as.character(legend_max))  # Format to 2 decimals# Bottom/right margins (increase if elements are cut off)
)
dev.off()


svg(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_entero_secretory_DCM_MS_depth_30042025.svg\), width = 6, height = 2)  # Adjust width/height as needed
pheatmap(
  Depth_DCM_entero_secretory,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = TRUE,  # Hide cell IDs
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_entero_secretory$transition)), # Add gaps between transition groups
  #scale = \column\,
  annotation_legend = FALSE,
  annotation_colors = list(
    Transition = c(
      Enterocyte_to_Enterocyte = \darkgreen\,
      Enterocyte_to_Paneth = \purple\,
      Paneth_to_Enterocyte = \steelblue\,
      Goblet_to_Enterocyte = \#FFFF99\,
      Tuft_to_Enterocyte = \#B15928\,
      Enteroendocrine_to_Enterocyte = \#8DD3C7\
    )
  ),
  main = \ Absorptive vs. SecretoryModule Scores DCM\
)


dev.off()



transition_cells_entero_secretory <- transition_cells_entero_secretory %>%
  mutate(transition = factor(transition, levels = transition_order_entero_secretory)) %>%

  select(Enterocyte1_RNA,Paneth1_RNA,Tuft1_RNA, Goblet1_RNA, Enteroendocrine1_RNA) %>%  # Select score columns

dev.off()


svg(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_enterocyte_secretory_RNA_MS_depth_30042025.svg\), width = 6, height = 2)
