```r
ordered <- sort(unique(int_meta_DCM2$transition))

transition_cells_all <- int_meta_DCM2 %>%
  mutate(transition = factor(transition, levels = ordered)) %>%
  arrange(transition)  # Sort rows by transition


transition_cells_secretory2 <- transition_cells_all %>%
  filter(!grepl(\ISC\, transition))
ordered_toISC <- sort(unique(transition_cells_toISC$transition))

transition_cells_scretory2 <- transition_cells_secretory2 %>%
  mutate(transition = factor(transition, levels = ordered_toISC)) %>%
  arrange(transition)  # Sort rows by transition


# Create a matrix (rows = cells, columns = Tuft1/Goblet1)
heatmap_data_secretory2 <- transition_cells_secretory2 %>%
  select(Enterocyte1,Paneth1,Enteroendocrine1,Tuft1, Goblet1) %>%  # Select score columns
  t()                        # Transpose to genes x cells
heatmap_data_RNA_secretory2 <- transition_cells_secretory2 %>%
  select(Enterocyte1_RNA,Paneth1_RNA,Enteroendocrine1_RNA,Tuft1_RNA, Goblet1_RNA) %>%  # Select score columns
  t()   
annotation_col_secretory2 <- data.frame(
  Transition = transition_cells_secretory2$transition,
  Dox = transition_cells_secretory2$Dox,
  row.names = transition_cells_secretory2$Sample_RNA
)
# Add cell IDs as column names
colnames(heatmap_data_secretory2) <- transition_cells_secretory2$Sample_RNA
heatmap_data_secretory_pulse2 <- heatmap_data_secretory2[,transition_cells_secretory2$Dox == \48hDox\]
heatmap_data_secretory_chase2 <- heatmap_data_secretory2[,transition_cells_secretory2$Dox == \48hDox-72hChase\]
#RNA
colnames(heatmap_data_RNA_secretory2) <- transition_cells_secretory2$Sample_RNA
heatmap_data_RNA_secretory_pulse2 <- heatmap_data_RNA_secretory2[,transition_cells_secretory2$Dox == \48hDox\]
heatmap_data_RNA_secretory_chase2 <- heatmap_data_RNA_secretory2[,transition_cells_secretory2$Dox == \48hDox-72hChase\]

# Annotation for transitions (column-wise)
annotation_col_secretory2 <- data.frame(
  Transition = transition_cells_secretory2$transition,
  Dox = transition_cells_secretory2$Dox,
  row.names = transition_cells_secretory2$Sample_RNA
)
transition_cells_secretory_pulse2 <- transition_cells_secretory2[transition_cells_secretory2$Dox == \48hDox\,]
transition_cells_secretory_chase2 <- transition_cells_secretory2[transition_cells_secretory2$Dox == \48hDox-72hChase\,]

annotation_col_pulse_secretory2 <- data.frame(
  Transition = transition_cells_secretory2$transition,
  row.names = transition_cells_secretory2$Sample_RNA
)

transitions_secretory2 <- transitions[!grepl(\ISC\,transitions)]

# Assign colors (one per transition)
transition_colors_secretory2<- setNames(publication_colors_30[1:length(transitions_secretory2)], transitions_secretory2)
dox_colors_secretory2<- setNames(publication_colors_30[1:length(unique(transition_cells_secretory2$Dox))], unique(transition_cells_secretory2$Dox))
# Plot
heatmap_data_secretory2_t <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data_secretory2)))

z_min <- min(heatmap_data_secretory2_t, na.rm = TRUE)
z_max <- max(heatmap_data_secretory2_t, na.rm = TRUE)

svg(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_secretory_transitions_MS_DCM_t_25042025.svg\), width = 18, height = 10)  # Adjust width/height as needed

pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_secretory2_t,
  annotation_col = annotation_col_secretory2,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = F,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = TRUE,  # Hide cell IDs
  scale=\column\,
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_secretory2$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  main = \Transitions Module Scores DCM\,
  annotation_colors = list(Transition = transition_colors_secretory2,
                           Dox = dox_colors_secretory2),
  cellheight = 12,
  fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300),
 # legend_breaks = c(z_min, z_max),  # ONLY show min and max
#  legend_labels = c(round(z_min,2), round(z_max,2)),
  legend = TRUE,
  fontsize = 8,                # Smaller font for legend labels
  keysize = 0.5,               # Width of color key (default=1.5)
  keyheight = 0.2,             # Height of color key (default=0.5)
  keypar = list(cex = 0.5),    # Shrink legend elements
  margins = c(5, 10) 
)
dev.off()
heatmap_data_RNA_secretory2_t <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data_RNA_secretory2)))

z_min <- min(heatmap_data_RNA_secretory_t, na.rm = TRUE)
z_max <- max(heatmap_data_RNA_secretory_t, na.rm = TRUE)

svg(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_secretory_transitions_MS_RNA_t_25042025.svg\), width = 18, height = 10)  # Adjust width/height as needed
pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_RNA_secretory2_t,
  annotation_col = annotation_col_secretory2,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = TRUE,  # Hide cell IDs
  scale=\column\,
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_secretory2$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  main = \Transitions Module Scores RNA\,
  annotation_colors = list(Transition = transition_colors_secretory2,
                           Dox = dox_colors_secretory2),
  cellheight = 12,
  fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300),
  #legend_breaks = c(z_min, z_max),  # ONLY show min and max
  #legend_labels = c(round(z_min,2), round(z_max,2)),
  legend = TRUE,
  fontsize = 8,                # Smaller font for legend labels
  keysize = 0.5,               # Width of color key (default=1.5)
  keyheight = 0.2,             # Height of color key (default=0.5)
  keypar = list(cex = 0.5),    # Shrink legend elements
  margins = c(5, 10) 
)
dev.off()

```r
ordered <- sort(unique(int_meta_DCM2$transition))

transition_cells_all <- int_meta_DCM2 %>%
  mutate(transition = factor(transition, levels = ordered)) %>%
  arrange(transition)  # Sort rows by transition


# Create a matrix (rows = cells, columns = Tuft1/Goblet1)
heatmap_data <- transition_cells_all %>%
  select(ISC1,Enterocyte1,Paneth1,Enteroendocrine1,Tuft1, Goblet1) %>%  # Select score columns
  t()                        # Transpose to genes x cells
heatmap_data_RNA <- transition_cells_all %>%
  select(ISC1_RNA,Enterocyte1_RNA,Paneth1_RNA,Enteroendocrine1_RNA,Tuft1_RNA, Goblet1_RNA) %>%  # Select score columns
  t()   
# Add cell IDs as column names
colnames(heatmap_data) <- transition_cells_all$Sample_RNA  # Replace 'cell_id' with your actual column name
colnames(heatmap_data_RNA) <- transition_cells_all$Sample_RNA  # Replace 'cell_id' with your actual column name

# Annotation for transitions (column-wise)
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Transition = transition_cells_all$transition,
  row.names = transition_cells_all$Sample_RNA
)

publication_colors_30 <- c(
  \#332288\, \#88CCEE\, \#44AA99\, \#117733\, \#999933\, \#DDCC77\, 
  \#CC6677\, \#882255\, \#AA4499\, \#DDDDDD\, \#1F78B4\, \#33A02C\, 
  \#E31A1C\, \#FDBF6F\, \#6A3D9A\,  
  \#A6CEE3\, \#FF7F00\, \#CAB2D6\, \#FFFF99\, \#B15928\, \#8DD3C7\,
  \#FB8072\, \#80B1D3\, \#FDB462\, \#B3DE69\, \#FCCDE5\, \#D9D9D9\,
  \#8DA0CB\, \#E78AC3\, \#A6D854\
)

transitions <- c(
  \Enterocyte_to_Enterocyte\, \Enterocyte_to_ISC\, \Enterocyte_to_Paneth\,
  \Enteroendocrine_to_Enterocyte\, \Enteroendocrine_to_Goblet\, 
  \Enteroendocrine_to_Paneth\, \Enteroendocrine_to_Tuft\,
  \Goblet_to_Enterocyte\, \Goblet_to_Enteroendocrine\, \Goblet_to_Goblet\,
  \Goblet_to_ISC\, \Goblet_to_Paneth\, \Goblet_to_Tuft\,
  \ISC_to_Enterocyte\, \ISC_to_Enteroendocrine\, \ISC_to_Goblet\,
  \ISC_to_ISC\, \ISC_to_Paneth\, \ISC_to_Tuft\,
  \Paneth_to_Enterocyte\, \Paneth_to_Enteroendocrine\, \Paneth_to_Goblet\,
  \Paneth_to_ISC\, \Paneth_to_Paneth\, \Paneth_to_Tuft\,
  \Tuft_to_Enterocyte\, \Tuft_to_Enteroendocrine\, \Tuft_to_Goblet\,
  \Tuft_to_ISC\, \Tuft_to_Tuft\
)

# Assign colors (one per transition)
transition_colors <- setNames(publication_colors_30[1:length(transitions)], transitions)
# Plot
heatmap_data_t <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data)))

heatmap_data_RNA_t <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data_RNA)))
order <- c(\ISC1\,\Enterocyte1\,\Goblet1\,\Paneth1\,\Tuft1\,\Enteroendocrine1\)
heatmap_data_t2 <- heatmap_data_t[order,]
pdf(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_all_transitions_MS_DCM_t_25042025.pdf\), width = 18, height = 10)  # Adjust width/height as needed
pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_t2,
  annotation_col = annotation_col2,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = F,  # Hide cell IDs
  #scale=\column\,
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_all$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  main = \Transitions Module Scores DCM\,
  annotation_colors = list(Transition = transition_colors),
       cellheight = 12,
     fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300),
 #legend_breaks = c(z_min, z_max),  # ONLY show min and max
  #legend_labels = c(round(z_min,2), round(z_max,2)),
  legend = TRUE,
  fontsize = 8,                # Smaller font for legend labels
  keysize = 0.5,               # Width of color key (default=1.5)
  keyheight = 0.2,             # Height of color key (default=0.5)
  keypar = list(cex = 0.5),    # Shrink legend elements
  margins = c(5, 10)           # Adjust plot margins if needed
# Format to 2 decimals# Bottom/right margins (increase if elements are cut off)
)
dev.off()
order_RNA <- paste0(order,\_RNA\)
heatmap_data_RNA_t2 <- heatmap_data_RNA_t[order_RNA,]
annotation_col2 <- annotation_col
annotation_col2$cellid <- NULL
pdf(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_all_transitions_MS_RNA_t_25042025.pdf\), width = 18, height = 10)  # Adjust width/height as needed

pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_RNA_t2,
  annotation_col = annotation_col2,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = FALSE,  # Hide cell IDs
  scale=\column\,
 annotation_legend = TRUE,

  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_all$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  main = \Transitions Module Scores RNA\,
  annotation_colors = list(Transition = transition_colors),
       cellheight = 12,
     fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300),
 #legend_breaks = c(z_min, z_max),  # ONLY show min and max
  #legend_labels = c(round(z_min,2), round(z_max,2)),
  legend = TRUE,
  fontsize = 8,                # Smaller font for legend labels
  keysize = 0.5,               # Width of color key (default=1.5)
  keyheight = 0.2,             # Height of color key (default=0.5)
  keypar = list(cex = 0.5),    # Shrink legend elements
  margins = c(5, 10)           # Adjust plot margins if needed
# Format to 2 decimals# Bottom/right margins (increase if elements are cut off)
)

dev.off()

```r
```r
heatmap_data_t
heatmap_data_RNA_t

int_meta_DCM2_2$Sample_RNA == colnames(heatmap_data_t)
int_meta_DCM2_2 <- int_meta_DCM2[match(colnames(heatmap_data_t), int_meta_DCM2$Sample_RNA),]
heatmap_data_t2 <- t(heatmap_data_t)
colnames(heatmap_data_t2) <- paste0(colnames(heatmap_data_t2),\_scaled\)
int_meta_DCM2_3 <- cbind(int_meta_DCM2_2,heatmap_data_t2)

indices <- grep(\1_scaled\, names(int_meta_DCM2_3))
subset_df <- int_meta_DCM2_3[, indices]

colnames(subset_df)

a<-as.data.frame(colnames(subset_df)[apply(subset_df,1,which.max)])
a$cleaned_names <- gsub(\1_scaled\, \\, a$`colnames(subset_df)[apply(subset_df, 1, which.max)]`)
int_meta_DCM2_3$cell_type_MS <- a$cleaned_names

int_meta_DCM2_4 <- int_meta_DCM2_3 %>%
  filter(cell_identity_int2 == cell_type_MS)

comeback <- c(    \RNA_B17_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_B20_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_C15_Plate_1\,
    \RNA_H20_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_P18_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_C15_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_D14_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_G8_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_O6_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_F24_Plate_2\)

int_meta_DCM2_4[int_meta_DCM2_4$Sample_RNA %in% comeback,]
transition_cells_all_filtered <- transition_cells_all[match(int_meta_DCM2_4$Sample_RNA, transition_cells_all$Sample_RNA),]
heatmap_data_t_filtered <- heatmap_data_t[,match(int_meta_DCM2_4$Sample_RNA, colnames(heatmap_data_t))] 
heatmap_data_RNA_t_filtered <- heatmap_data_RNA_t[,match(int_meta_DCM2_4$Sample_RNA, colnames(heatmap_data_RNA_t))] 


pdf(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_all_transitions_MS_DCM_t_filtered.svg\), width = 18, height = 10)  # Adjust width/height as needed
pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_t_filtered,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = FALSE,  # Hide cell IDs
  scale=\column\,
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_all_filtered$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  main = \Transitions Module Scores DCM\,
  annotation_colors = list(Transition = transition_colors),
       cellheight = 12,
     fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300),
 #legend_breaks = c(z_min, z_max),  # ONLY show min and max
  #legend_labels = c(round(z_min,2), round(z_max,2)),
  legend = TRUE,
  fontsize = 8,                # Smaller font for legend labels
  keysize = 0.5,               # Width of color key (default=1.5)
  keyheight = 0.2,             # Height of color key (default=0.5)
  keypar = list(cex = 0.5),    # Shrink legend elements
  margins = c(5, 10)           # Adjust plot margins if needed
# Format to 2 decimals# Bottom/right margins (increase if elements are cut off)
)
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_all_transitions_MS_RNA_t_filtered.pdf\), width = 18, height = 10)  # Adjust width/height as needed

pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_RNA_t_filtered,
  annotation_col = annotation_col2,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = FALSE,  # Hide cell IDs
  scale=\column\,
 annotation_legend = TRUE,

  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_all_filtered$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  main = \Transitions Module Scores RNA\,
  annotation_colors = list(Transition = transition_colors),
       cellheight = 12,
     fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300),
 #legend_breaks = c(z_min, z_max),  # ONLY show min and max
  #legend_labels = c(round(z_min,2), round(z_max,2)),
  legend = TRUE,
  fontsize = 8,                # Smaller font for legend labels
  keysize = 0.5,               # Width of color key (default=1.5)
  keyheight = 0.2,             # Height of color key (default=0.5)
  keypar = list(cex = 0.5),    # Shrink legend elements
  margins = c(5, 10)           # Adjust plot margins if needed
# Format to 2 decimals# Bottom/right margins (increase if elements are cut off)
)

dev.off()

```r
int_meta_DCM2_2$Sample_RNA == colnames(heatmap_data_RNA_t)

heatmap_data_RNA_t2 <- t(heatmap_data_RNA_t)
colnames(heatmap_data_RNA_t2) <- paste0(colnames(heatmap_data_RNA_t2),\RNA_scaled\)
int_meta_DCM2_3_RNA <- cbind(int_meta_DCM2_2,heatmap_data_RNA_t2)

indices <- grep(\RNA_scaled\, names(int_meta_DCM2_3_RNA))
subset_df <- int_meta_DCM2_3_RNA[, indices]

colnames(subset_df)

a<-as.data.frame(colnames(subset_df)[apply(subset_df,1,which.max)])
a$cleaned_names <- gsub(\1_RNARNA_scaled\, \\, a$`colnames(subset_df)[apply(subset_df, 1, which.max)]`)
int_meta_DCM2_3_RNA$cell_type_MS <- a$cleaned_names

int_meta_DCM2_4_RNA <- int_meta_DCM2_3_RNA %>%
  filter(cell_identity_int2_RNA == cell_type_MS)

comeback <- c(    \RNA_B17_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_B20_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_C15_Plate_1\,
    \RNA_H20_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_P18_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_C15_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_D14_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_G8_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_O6_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_F24_Plate_2\)

int_meta_DCM2_4_RNA[int_meta_DCM2_4_RNA$Sample_RNA %in% comeback,]
transition_cells_all_filtered_RNA <- transition_cells_all[match(int_meta_DCM2_4_RNA$Sample_RNA, transition_cells_all$Sample_RNA),]
heatmap_data_t_filtered2 <- heatmap_data_t[,match(int_meta_DCM2_4_RNA$Sample_RNA, colnames(heatmap_data_t))] 
heatmap_data_RNA_t_filtered2 <- heatmap_data_RNA_t[,match(int_meta_DCM2_4_RNA$Sample_RNA, colnames(heatmap_data_RNA_t))] 

heatmap_data_t_filtered3 <- heatmap_data_t_filtered[,match(colnames(heatmap_data_t_filtered2), colnames(heatmap_data_t_filtered))]
heatmap_data_t_filtered3 <- t(na.omit(t(heatmap_data_t_filtered3))) 
transition_cells_all_filtered3 <- transition_cells_all[match(colnames(heatmap_data_t_filtered3), transition_cells_all$Sample_RNA),]

heatmap_data_RNA_t_filtered3 <- heatmap_data_RNA_t[,match(colnames(heatmap_data_t_filtered3), colnames(heatmap_data_RNA_t))] 
heatmap_data_RNA_t_filtered3[,colnames(heatmap_data_RNA_t_filtered3) %in% comeback]



svg(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_all_transitions_MS_DCM_t_filtered_RNA.svg\), width = 18, height = 10)  # Adjust width/height as needed
pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_t_filtered3,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = FALSE,  # Hide cell IDs
  scale=\column\,
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_all_filtered3$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  main = \Transitions Module Scores DCM\,
  annotation_colors = list(Transition = transition_colors),
       cellheight = 12,
     fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300),
 #legend_breaks = c(z_min, z_max),  # ONLY show min and max
  #legend_labels = c(round(z_min,2), round(z_max,2)),
  legend = TRUE,
  fontsize = 8,                # Smaller font for legend labels
  keysize = 0.5,               # Width of color key (default=1.5)
  keyheight = 0.2,             # Height of color key (default=0.5)
  keypar = list(cex = 0.5),    # Shrink legend elements
  margins = c(5, 10)           # Adjust plot margins if needed
# Format to 2 decimals# Bottom/right margins (increase if elements are cut off)
)
dev.off()

svg(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_all_transitions_MS_RNA_t_filtered_RNA.svg\), width = 18, height = 10)  # Adjust width/height as needed

pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_RNA_t_filtered3,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = FALSE,  # Hide cell IDs
  scale=\column\,
 annotation_legend = TRUE,

  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_all_filtered3$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  main = \Transitions Module Scores RNA\,
  annotation_colors = list(Transition = transition_colors),
       cellheight = 12,
     fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300),
 #legend_breaks = c(z_min, z_max),  # ONLY show min and max
  #legend_labels = c(round(z_min,2), round(z_max,2)),
  legend = TRUE,
  fontsize = 8,                # Smaller font for legend labels
  keysize = 0.5,               # Width of color key (default=1.5)
  keyheight = 0.2,             # Height of color key (default=0.5)
  keypar = list(cex = 0.5),    # Shrink legend elements
  margins = c(5, 10)           # Adjust plot margins if needed
# Format to 2 decimals# Bottom/right margins (increase if elements are cut off)
)

dev.off()

```r
int_meta_DCM2$Confidence <- int_meta_DCM2 %>% colnames(heatmap_data_RNA_t_filtered3)
library(dplyr)

int_meta_DCM2_V1 <- int_meta_DCM2 %>%
  mutate(confidence = ifelse(Sample_RNA %in% colnames(heatmap_data_RNA_t_filtered3), \Confident\, \Ambiguous\))
int_meta_DCM2_V1$confidence <- factor(int_meta_DCM2_V1$confidence, levels = c(\Confident\,\Ambiguous\))

int_meta_DCM2_V2 <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(int_meta_DCM2_V1),
                               \DCM_ID\ =  int_meta_DCM2_V1$Sample_Meth,
                               \RNA_ID\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$Sample_RNA,
                               \DCM_celltype\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$cell_identity_int2,
                               \RNA_celltype\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$cell_identity_int2_RNA,
                               \Transition\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$transition,
                               \Filtered\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$confidence,
                                 \MS_Tuft_RNA\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$Tuft1_RNA,
                                 \MS_Goblet_RNA\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$Goblet1_RNA,
                                 \MS_ISC_RNA\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$ISC1_RNA,
                                 \MS_EEC_RNA\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$Enteroendocrine1_RNA,
                                 \MS_Enterocyte_RNA\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$Enterocyte1_RNA,
                                 \MS_Paneth_RNA\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$Paneth1_RNA,
                                 \MS_Tuft_DCM\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$Tuft1,
                                 \MS_Goblet_DCM\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$Goblet1,
                                 \MS_ISC_DCM\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$ISC1,
                                 \MS_EEC_DCM\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$Enteroendocrine1,
                                 \MS_Enterocyte_DCM\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$Enterocyte1,
                                 \MS_Paneth_DCM\ = int_meta_DCM2_V1$Paneth1)

write.csv(int_meta_DCM2_V2,\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/data_for_joachim/metadata_transitions_flagged.csv\)

ggplot(int_meta_DCM2_V1, aes(x=confidence, y=nCount_RNA))+
geom_boxplot()+
    stat_compare_means(
      method = \wilcox.test\,
      label = \p.signif\,
      tip.length = 0.1, vjust = 1.5
    ) +   # Adds t-test result
       theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5, color=\black\),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, hjust = 1, color=\black\),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, angle=45,  hjust = 1, color=\black\),

    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11, color=\black\),
    legend.position = \top\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, \cm\))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 2))+
  labs(
    title = \\,
    y = \DCM Counts\,
    x = \\)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\nCount_DCM_depth_confidentvsambiguous.png\),dpi=300, width = 2, height =3)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\nCount_DCM_depth_confidentvsambiguous.pdf\),dpi=300, width = 2, height =3)

ggplot(int_meta_DCM2_V1, aes(x=confidence, y=nCount_RNA_RNA))+
geom_boxplot()+
    stat_compare_means(
      method = \wilcox.test\,
      label = \p.signif\,
      tip.length = 0.01
    ) +   # Adds t-test result
        theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5, color=\black\),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, hjust = 1, color=\black\),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, angle=45,  hjust = 1, color=\black\),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11, color=\black\),
    legend.position = \top\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, \cm\))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 2))+
  labs(
    title = \\,
    y = \RNA Counts\,
    x = \\)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\nCount_RNA_depth_confidentvsambiguous.png\),dpi=300, width = 2, height =3)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\nCount_RNA_depth_confidentvsambiguous.pdf\),dpi=300, width = 2, height =3)

```r

# First, get total number of cells per Dox condition
total_cells_per_dox <- int_meta_DCM2 %>%
  group_by(Dox) %>%
  summarise(total_cells = n())

# Then, compute ISC transitions and join with total cell counts
results_tuft <- int_meta_DCM3 %>%
  # Filter cells where RNA identity is ISC (initial state)
  filter(grepl(\Tuft\, cell_identity_int2, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(Dox) %>%
  summarise(
    Tuft_to_Tuft = sum(grepl(\Tuft\, cell_identity_int2_RNA, ignore.case = TRUE)),
    total_Tuft = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Tuft_to_other = total_Tuft - Tuft_to_Tuft
  ) %>%
  left_join(total_cells_per_dox, by = \Dox\) %>%
  mutate(
    perc_Tuft_to_Tuft = (Tuft_to_Tuft / total_cells) * 100,
    perc_Tuft_to_other = (Tuft_to_other / total_cells) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Reshape for plotting
plot_data <- results_tuft %>%
  select(Dox, perc_Tuft_to_Tuft, perc_Tuft_to_other) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(\perc\),
    names_to = \transition\,
    values_to = \percentage\
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    transition = case_when(
      transition == \perc_Tuft_to_Tuft\ ~ \Remain Tuft\,
      transition == \perc_Tuft_to_other\ ~ \Become non-Tuft\
    )
  )

# Create barplot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Dox, y = percentage, fill = transition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = \identity\, position = \dodge\) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf(\%.1f%%\, percentage)),
    size=2.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 1),
    vjust = -0.55
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(\Remain Tuft\ = \#4CAF50\, \Become non-Tuft\ = \#F44336\),
    labels = c(\Remain Tuft\ =\Tuft DCM → Tuft RNA\ , \Become non-Tuft\ = \Tuft DCM → Non-Tuft RNA\)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = \Fate of Tuft Cells\,
    x = \\,
    y = \Percentage of Cells (%)\,
    fill = \Outcome\
  ) +
  ylim(0, 100) +
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5, color=\black\),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, hjust = 1, color=\black\),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, angle=45,  hjust = 1, color=\black\),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.5),

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Tuft_transition_per_condition.png\),dpi=300, width = 2, height =3)
ggsave(\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/Harber/Large_harber_plate_integration/Transitions/ISC_differentiation_dox_condition_withinISC.png\, width = 3, height =3)

# First, get total number of cells per Dox condition
total_cells_per_dox <- int_meta_DCM2 %>%
  group_by(Dox) %>%
  summarise(total_cells = n())

# Then, compute ISC transitions and join with total cell counts
results_Enterocyte <- int_meta_DCM2 %>%
  # Filter cells where RNA identity is ISC (initial state)
  filter(grepl(\Enterocyte\, cell_identity_int2, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(Dox) %>%
  summarise(
    Enterocyte_to_Enterocyte = sum(grepl(\Enterocyte\, cell_identity_int2_RNA, ignore.case = TRUE)),
    total_Enterocyte = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Enterocyte_to_other = total_Enterocyte - Enterocyte_to_Enterocyte
  ) %>%
  left_join(total_cells_per_dox, by = \Dox\) %>%
  mutate(
    perc_Enterocyte_to_Enterocyte = (Enterocyte_to_Enterocyte / total_cells) * 100,
    perc_Enterocyte_to_other = (Enterocyte_to_other / total_cells) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Reshape for plotting
plot_data_ent <- results_Enterocyte %>%
  select(Dox, perc_Enterocyte_to_Enterocyte, perc_Enterocyte_to_other) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(\perc\),
    names_to = \transition\,
    values_to = \percentage\
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    transition = case_when(
      transition == \perc_Enterocyte_to_Enterocyte\ ~ \Remain Enterocyte\,
      transition == \perc_Enterocyte_to_other\ ~ \Become non-Enterocyte\
    )
  )

# Create barplot
ggplot(plot_data_ent, aes(x = Dox, y = percentage, fill = transition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = \identity\, position = \dodge\) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf(\%.1f%%\, percentage)),
    size=2.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 1),
    vjust = -0.55
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(\Remain Enterocyte\ = \#4CAF50\, \Become non-Enterocyte\ = \#F44336\),
    labels = c(\Remain Enterocyte\ =\Enterocyte DCM → Enterocyte RNA\ , \Become non-Enterocyte\ = \Enterocyte DCM → Non-Enterocyte RNA\)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = \Fate of Enterocyte Cells\,
    x = \\,
    y = \Percentage of Cells (%)\,
    fill = \Outcome\
  ) +
  ylim(0, 100) +
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5, color=\black\),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, hjust = 1, color=\black\),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, angle=45,  hjust = 1, color=\black\),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11, color=\black\),
    legend.position = \top\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, \cm\))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 2))

  byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(
    Category = c(\Ent_to_Ent\, \Ent_to_other\),
    Dox = c(\48hDox\, \48hDox-72hChase\)
  )
)
fisher.test(cell_matrix_ent)

```r
#Cell switch proportions
integrated_seurat$Dataset[17613:18109] <- \pRNA\ 
integrated_seurat$Dataset[18110:18377] <- \pDCM\ 
int_RNA <- integrated_seurat@meta.data[17613:18109,]
int_DCM <- integrated_seurat@meta.data[18110:18377,]

int_RNA2 <- int_RNA[match(int_DCM$Sample_RNA, int_RNA$Sample_RNA),]
int_DCM$Sample_RNA == int_RNA2$Sample_RNA
int_RNA2$cell_identity_int2_DCM <- int_DCM$cell_identity_int2

int_RNA2$Same_Label_identity <- int_RNA2$cell_identity_int2 == int_RNA2$cell_identity_int2_DCM

int_RNA2 <- int_RNA2[!grepl(\^NA\,rownames(int_RNA2)), ]
int_meta_DCM2_4
# Step 3: Count occurrences of each label combination
label_counts <- int_meta_DCM2_4 %>%
  group_by(Dox, cell_identity_int2_RNA, cell_identity_int2) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop')

# Step 4: Calculate switched and non-switched counts
switched_counts <- label_counts %>%
  filter(cell_identity_int2_RNA != cell_identity_int2) %>%
  group_by(Dox)%>%
  summarise(total_switched = sum(count), .groups = 'drop')

non_switched_counts <- label_counts %>%
  filter(cell_identity_int2_RNA == cell_identity_int2) %>%
   group_by(Dox)%>%
  summarise(total_non_switched = sum(count), .groups = 'drop')

# Step 4: Combine the counts into a single data frame for plotting
plot_data <- data.frame(
  category = c(\Switched_Cells\, \Switched_Cells\,\Non-Switched_Cells\,\Non-Switched_Cells\),
  Dox = c(\48hDox\, \48hDox-72hChase\),
  count = c(switched_counts$total_switched, non_switched_counts$total_non_switched)
)

total_cells_48h <- switched_counts[switched_counts$Dox == \48hDox\,]$total_switched + non_switched_counts[non_switched_counts$Dox == \48hDox\,]$total_non_switched

total_cells_48h_chase <- switched_counts[switched_counts$Dox == \48hDox-72hChase\,]$total_switched + non_switched_counts[non_switched_counts$Dox == \48hDox-72hChase\,]$total_non_switched

total_cells = data.frame(Dox = c(\48hDox\,\48hDox-72hChase\),
                         Counts = c(total_cells_48h, total_cells_48h_chase)) 
plot_data2 <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Dox) %>%  # Group by condition (e.g., \48hDox\, \Minus\, etc.)
  mutate(
    percentage = count / sum(count) * 100  # % of total counts within each group
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 5: Create a stacked bar plot
p <- ggplot(data = plot_data2, aes(x = Dox, y = percentage, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = \identity\) +
  labs(y = \Percentage of Cells (%)\,
       x = \\) +
  #facet_wrap(~Dox, switch = \y\)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(\Switched_Cells\ = \lightblue\, \Non-Switched_Cells\ = \salmon\, \Total Cells\ = \lightgray\)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), \%\)),size = 11, size.unit = 'pt', position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5))+ 
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5, color=\black\),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, hjust = 1, color=\black\),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, angle=45,  hjust = 1, color=\black\),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11, color=\black\),
    legend.position = \top\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, \cm\))+
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

 g <- ggplotGrob(p)

# Extract all legend boxes
  legends <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == \guide-box\)]

# Save each legend manually (they're stacked in one box)
  legend_combined <- legends[[1]]  # Usually contains both

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Al_transition_proportion_per_DOX2_legend.png\),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =5.15, height = 0.2)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = \none\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Al_transition_proportion_per_DOX2.png\),p_nolegend, dpi=300, width = 3, height = 4)


#only Absorptive or secretory cells
int_meta_DCM3 <- int_meta_DCM2[int_meta_DCM2$cell_identity_int2 != \ISC\,]
int_meta_DCM2_4_1 <- int_meta_DCM2_4[int_meta_DCM2_4$cell_identity_int2 != \ISC\,]
# Step 3: Count occurrences of each label combination
label_counts <- int_meta_DCM3 %>%
  group_by(Dox, cell_identity_int2_RNA, cell_identity_int2) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop')

# Step 4: Calculate switched and non-switched counts
switched_counts <- label_counts %>%
  filter(cell_identity_int2_RNA != cell_identity_int2) %>%
  group_by(Dox)%>%
  summarise(total_switched = sum(count), .groups = 'drop')

non_switched_counts <- label_counts %>%
  filter(cell_identity_int2_RNA == cell_identity_int2) %>%
   group_by(Dox)%>%
  summarise(total_non_switched = sum(count), .groups = 'drop')

# Step 4: Combine the counts into a single data frame for plotting
plot_data <- data.frame(
  category = c(\Switched_Cells\, \Switched_Cells\,\Non-Switched_Cells\,\Non-Switched_Cells\),
  Dox = c(\48hDox\, \48hDox-72hChase\),
  count = c(switched_counts$total_switched, non_switched_counts$total_non_switched)
)

total_cells_48h <- switched_counts[switched_counts$Dox == \48hDox\,]$total_switched + non_switched_counts[non_switched_counts$Dox == \48hDox\,]$total_non_switched

total_cells_48h_chase <- switched_counts[switched_counts$Dox == \48hDox-72hChase\,]$total_switched + non_switched_counts[non_switched_counts$Dox == \48hDox-72hChase\,]$total_non_switched

total_cells = data.frame(Dox = c(\48hDox\,\48hDox-72hChase\),
                         Counts = c(total_cells_48h, total_cells_48h_chase)) 
plot_data2 <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Dox) %>%  # Group by condition (e.g., \48hDox\, \Minus\, etc.)
  mutate(
    percentage = count / sum(count) * 100  # % of total counts within each group
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_data2$percentage2 <- c(23/74*100,16/65*100,23/46*100,8/27*100)

# Step 5: Create a stacked bar plot
p <- ggplot(data = plot_data2, aes(x = Dox, y = percentage, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = \identity\, position = \dodge\) +
  labs(y = \Percentage of Cells (%)\,
       x = \\) +
  #facet_wrap(~Dox)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(\Switched_Cells\ = \lightblue\, \Non-Switched_Cells\ = \salmon\, \Total Cells\ = \lightgray\)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), \%\)),size = 11, size.unit = 'pt', position = position_dodge(width = 1),
    vjust = -0.55)+ 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(\Switched_Cells\ = \#4CAF50\, \Non-Switched_Cells\ = \lightblue\),
    labels = c(\Switched_Cells\ =\Non-Stable Absorptive-Secretory cells\ , \Non-Switched_Cells\ = \Stable Absorptive-Secretory cells\)
  ) +
  ylim(0,100)+
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5, color=\black\),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, hjust = 1, color=\black\),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, angle=0,  hjust = 1, color=\black\),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\, color=\black\),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = \black\, size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11, color=\black\),
    legend.position = \top\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, \cm\))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 2))
 g <- ggplotGrob(p)

# Extract all legend boxes
  legends <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == \guide-box\)]

# Save each legend manually (they're stacked in one box)
  legend_combined <- legends[[1]]  # Usually contains both


ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Abs_secre_transition_proportion_per_DOX2_legend.png\),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =5.15, height = 0.6)

  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = \none\)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Abs_secre_transition_proportion_per_DOX2.png\),p_nolegend, dpi=300, width = 4, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Abs_secre_transition_proportion_per_DOX2.pdf\),p, dpi=300, width = 4, height = 5)

int_RNA2$cell_identity_int2_DCM2 <- paste0(int_RNA2$cell_identity_int2_DCM,\_DCM\)



# Create a list to store frequency and percentage matrices for each induction time
frequency_matrices <- list()

# Loop through unique induction times (induction categories)
for (induction_category in unique(int_RNA2$Dox)) {
  
  # Filter the data based on the induction category
  subset <- int_RNA2[int_RNA2$Dox == induction_category, ]
  
  # Create a frequency matrix using table
  frequency_matrix <- table(subset$cell_identity_int2_DCM2, subset$cell_identity_int2)
  
  # Calculate percentages
  percentage_matrix <- prop.table(frequency_matrix, 1) # Row-wise percentages
  
  # Store both frequency and percentage matrices in the list
  frequency_matrices[[induction_category]] <- list(
    frequency = frequency_matrix,
    percentage = percentage_matrix
  )
  
    write.csv(frequency_matrix, paste0(\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/Harber/Large_harber_plate_integration/Transitions/Matrixes/frequency_matrix2_\, induction_category, \.csv\))
  write.csv(percentage_matrix, paste0(\/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/Harber/Large_harber_plate_integration/Transitions/Matrixes/percentage_matrix2_\, induction_category, \.csv\))
}
frequency_matrices


library(pheatmap)
library(grid)
library(Seurat)
library(reshape2)
frequency_matrices_pulse_chase <- frequency_matrices[[1]][[1]]
per_matrices_pulse_chase <- frequency_matrices[[1]][[2]]
frequency_matrices_pulse <- frequency_matrices[[2]][[1]]
per_matrices_pulse <- frequency_matrices[[2]][[2]]


melted_chase <- melt(frequency_matrices_pulse_chase)
new_order_dcm <- paste0(new_order,\_DCM\)
melted_chase$Var2 <- factor(melted_chase$Var2, levels = rev(new_order))
melted_chase$Var1 <- factor(melted_chase$Var1, levels = new_order_dcm)

ggplot(melted_chase, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf(\%.0f\, value)), size = 5) +  # Add cell values with 2 decimals
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = \blue\, mid = \white\, high = \red\, midpoint = 0.25) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(r = 10))
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    x = \DCM\,
    y = \RNA\,
    fill = \\,
    title = \Chase transitions\
  )+
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = \plain\, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, face = \plain\, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = \plain\),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank())
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\heatmap_chase_freq.png\), width = 5, height = 5, dpi=300)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\heatmap_chase_freq.pdf\), width = 5, height = 5, dpi=300)

```r
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
transitions <- data.frame(table(int_meta_DCM2$cell_identity_int2,int_meta_DCM2$cell_identity_int2_RNA,int_meta_DCM2$Dox))
colnames(transitions) <- c(\From\,\To\,\Dox\,\Freq\)


transitions_filtered <- data.frame(table(int_meta_DCM2_4$cell_identity_int2,int_meta_DCM2_4$cell_identity_int2_RNA,int_meta_DCM2_4$Dox))
colnames(transitions_filtered) <- c(\From\,\To\,\Dox\,\Freq\)
transitions_filtered$From_general <- ifelse(
  transitions_filtered$From == \Enterocyte\, \Absorptive\,
  ifelse(transitions_filtered$From %in% c(\Paneth\, \Goblet\, \Tuft\, \Enteroendocrine\), \Secretory\, \Stem\)
)
transitions_filtered$To_general <- ifelse(
  transitions_filtered$To == \Enterocyte\, \Absorptive\,
  ifelse(transitions_filtered$To %in% c(\Paneth\, \Goblet\, \Tuft\, \Enteroendocrine\), \Secretory\, \Stem\)
)

# 2. Assign edge properties
transitions <- transitions %>%
  mutate(
    Edge_Color = case_when(
      Freq == 0 ~ \white\,  # Zero-frequency = transparent white
      grepl(\Enterocyte\, To, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ \#1B9E77\,
      grepl(\Enterocyte\, From, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ \#D95F02\,
      TRUE ~ \gray\
    ),
    Edge_Type = ifelse(Edge_Color == \#D95F02\, \dashed\, \solid\),
    Edge_Alpha = ifelse(Freq == 0, 0, 1)  # Make zero-freq arrows transparent
  )
# 2. Assign edge properties
transitions_filtered <- transitions_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    Edge_Color = case_when(
      Freq == 0 ~ \white\,
      
      From_general == \Secretory\ & To_general == \Absorptive\ ~ \#1B9E77\,   # green
      From_general == \Secretory\ & To_general == \Secretory\  ~ \#2C7BB6\,   # orange
      From_general == \Secretory\ & To_general == \Stem\       ~ \#FBAF00\,   # purple
      From_general == \Absorptive\ & To_general == \Stem\      ~ \#D62728\,   # pink
      
      TRUE ~ \gray\  # fallback
    ),
    
    Edge_Type = \solid\,  # if all are solid; modify if needed
    Edge_Alpha = ifelse(Freq == 0, 0, 1)
  )



# 3. Create unified layout (using ALL nodes)
all_nodes <- unique(c(levels(transitions$From), levels(transitions$To)))
g_unified <- graph_from_data_frame(
  data.frame(from = all_nodes[1], to = all_nodes[1]), # Dummy edge
  vertices = data.frame(name = all_nodes)
)
layout_unified <- create_layout(g_unified, layout = \fr\)

# 4. Plotting function


plot_transition_network <- function(data, condition) {
  # Create graph object
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(
    data %>% mutate(From = as.character(From), To = as.character(To)),
    directed = TRUE
  )
  
  # Calculate hierarchical layout
  node_levels <- data %>%
    group_by(From) %>%
    summarise(out_freq = sum(Freq)) %>%
    full_join(
      data %>% group_by(To) %>% summarise(in_freq = sum(Freq)),
      by = c(\From\ = \To\)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      level = rank(-(coalesce(in_freq, 0) + coalesce(out_freq, 0))),
      name = From
    )
  
  layout <- create_layout(
    g,
    layout = \sugiyama\,
    weights = data$Freq,
    hgap = 50,
    vgap = 30
  ) %>%
    left_join(node_levels, by = \name\) %>%
    mutate(
      y = level,
      x = as.numeric(factor(name))
    )
  
  # Add edge attributes
  E(g)$Freq <- data$Freq
  E(g)$Edge_Color <- data$Edge_Color
  E(g)$Edge_Type <- ifelse(data$Edge_Color == \#1B9E77\, \dashed\,
                          ifelse(data$Edge_Color == \#D95F02\, \solid\, \dashed\))
  E(g)$Edge_Alpha <- data$Edge_Alpha
  
  p <- ggraph(g, layout = \manual\, x = layout$x, y = layout$y) +
    # Regular edges
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
        strength = curve_strength,
        filter = !edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = \closed\, 
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        angle = 20
      ),
      end_cap = circle(5, 'mm'),
      start_cap = circle(12, 'mm'),
      lineend = \round\,
      linejoin = \round\
    ) +
    # Improved self-loops with better arrow placement
    geom_edge_loop(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
         strength = 1.2,
        filter = edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = \closed\,
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        ends = \last\  # Ensure arrow appears at end
      ),
      strength = 1.2,  # Increased to make loop tighter
      direction = 45,   # Angle for better arrow visibility
      start_cap = circle(5, 'mm'),  # Starts farther from node
      end_cap = circle(12, 'mm'),     # Points closer to node
      lineend = \round\,
      linejoin = \round\,
      n = 100          # Smoother curve
    ) +
    # Rest of the styling...
    scale_edge_linetype_manual(
      name = \Transition Type\,
      values = c(\dashed\, \solid\),
      labels = c(\To Enterocyte\, \From Enterocyte\)
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_identity(
      name = \Transition Type\,
      breaks = c(\#1B9E77\, \#D95F02\, \gray\),
      labels = c(\To Enterocyte\, \From Enterocyte\, \Other transitions\),
      guide = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          edge_width = 1.5,
          linetype = c(\dashed\, \solid\, \dashed\),
          alpha = 1
        ),
        order = 1
      )
    ) +
    scale_edge_width(
      range = c(0.3, 3),
      name = \Frequency\,
      guide = guide_legend(order = 2)
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
      size = 12,
      color = \white\,
      fill = \darkred\,
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 1
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = name), 
      color = \black\,
      size = 4.5,
      fontface = \bold\,
      family = \sans\,
      repel = TRUE,
      box.padding = 0.5
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(
      title = condition,
      subtitle = \Hierarchical transition network\
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = \right\,
      plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 2), \cm\)
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1.2)
  
  return(p)
}

plot_transition_network <- function(data, condition) {
  # Create graph object
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(
    data %>% mutate(From = as.character(From), To = as.character(To)),
    directed = TRUE
  )
  
  # Calculate hierarchical layout
  node_levels <- data %>%
    group_by(From) %>%
    summarise(out_freq = sum(Freq)) %>%
    full_join(
      data %>% group_by(To) %>% summarise(in_freq = sum(Freq)),
      by = c(\From\ = \To\)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      level = rank(-(coalesce(in_freq, 0) + coalesce(out_freq, 0))),
      name = From
    )
  
  layout <- create_layout(
    g,
    layout = \sugiyama\,
    weights = data$Freq,
    hgap = 50,
    vgap = 30
  ) %>%
    left_join(node_levels, by = \name\) %>%
    mutate(
      y = level,
      x = as.numeric(factor(name))
    )
  
  # Add edge attributes with custom dash patterns
  E(g)$Freq <- data$Freq
  E(g)$Edge_Color <- data$Edge_Color
  E(g)$Edge_Type <- ifelse(data$Edge_Color == \#1B9E77\, \solid\,
                          ifelse(data$Edge_Color == \#D95F02\, \solid\, \solid\))
  E(g)$Edge_Alpha <- data$Edge_Alpha
  
  p <- ggraph(g, layout = \manual\, x = layout$x, y = layout$y) +
    # Regular edges with custom dash patterns
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,  # Now using custom patterns
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
        filter = !edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = \closed\, 
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        angle = 20
      ),
      end_cap = circle(8, 'mm'),
      start_cap = circle(8, 'mm'),
      lineend = \round\,
      linejoin = \round\
    ) +
    # Self-loops with custom dash patterns
    geom_edge_loop(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,  # Consistent with regular edges
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
        filter = edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = \closed\,
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        ends = \last\
      ),
      strength = 1.2,
      direction = 45,
      start_cap = circle(12, 'mm'),
      end_cap = circle(5, 'mm'),
      lineend = \round\,
      linejoin = \round\,
      n = 100
    ) +
    # Custom line types with more pronounced dashes
    scale_edge_linetype_manual(
      name = \Transition Type\,
      values = c(\solid\, \solid\, \solid\,\solid\),  # More pronounced dashes
      labels = c(\From Secretory To Absorptive\, \From Secretory To Secretory\, \From Secretory To Stem\, \From Absorptive To Stem\,\Other transitions\),
      guide = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          edge_width = 1.5,
          alpha = 1
        )
      )
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_identity(
      name = \Transition Type\,
      breaks = c(\#1B9E77\, \#2C7BB6\, \#FBAF00\,\#D62728\,\gray\),
      labels = c(\From Secretory To Absorptive\, \From Secretory To Secretory\, \From Secretory To Stem\, \From Absorptive To Stem\,\Other transitions\),
      guide = \none\  # Color info now shown in linetype legend
    ) +
    scale_edge_width(
      range = c(0.3, 3),
      name = \Frequency\,
      guide = guide_legend(order = 2)
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
      size = 12,
      color = \white\,
      fill = \darkred\,
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 1
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = name), 
      color = \black\,
      size = 4.5,
      fontface = \bold\,
      family = \sans\,
      repel = TRUE,
      box.padding = 0.5
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(
      title = condition,
      subtitle = \Hierarchical transition network\
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = \right\,
      plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 2), \cm\),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.5, \cm\)  # Wider legend keys for better dash visibility
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1.2)
  
  return(p)
}

  transitions %>% filter(Dox == \48hDox\), 
  \48hDox\
)

  \48hDox-72hChase\
)
get_legend_only <- function(plot) {
  # Extract the legend
  legend <- cowplot::get_legend(plot)
  
  # Create a blank plot with just the legend
  legend_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(legend)
  
  return(legend_plot)
}

transitions_filtered <- transitions_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    pair_id = ifelse(From < To, paste(From, To, sep = \|\), paste(To, From, sep = \|\))
  ) %>%
  group_by(pair_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_bidirectional = n() > 1,
    curve_strength = ifelse(is_bidirectional, ifelse(From < To, 0.3, -0.3), 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_transition_network <- function(data, condition) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggraph)
  library(igraph)
  library(tidygraph)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(grid)

  # Preprocess: mark bidirectional edges and assign curvature
  data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    From = as.character(From),
    To = as.character(To),
    pair_id = ifelse(From < To, paste(From, To, sep = \|\), paste(To, From, sep = \|\))
  ) %>%
  group_by(pair_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_bidirectional = n() > 1,
    curve_strength = ifelse(is_bidirectional, ifelse(From < To, 0.3, -0.3), 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

  # Create graph object
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(
    data %>% mutate(From = as.character(From), To = as.character(To)),
    directed = TRUE
  )

  # Add edge attributes
  E(g)$Freq <- data$Freq
  E(g)$Edge_Color <- data$Edge_Color
  E(g)$Edge_Type <- ifelse(
    data$Edge_Color == \#1B9E77\, \solid\,
    ifelse(data$Edge_Color == \#D95F02\, \solid\, \solid\)
  )
  E(g)$Edge_Alpha <- data$Edge_Alpha
  E(g)$curve_strength <- data$curve_strength

  # Calculate hierarchical layout
  node_levels <- data %>%
    group_by(From) %>%
    summarise(out_freq = sum(Freq)) %>%
    full_join(
      data %>% group_by(To) %>% summarise(in_freq = sum(Freq)),
      by = c(\From\ = \To\)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      level = rank(-(coalesce(in_freq, 0) + coalesce(out_freq, 0))),
      name = From
    )

  layout <- create_layout(
    g,
    layout = \sugiyama\,
    weights = data$Freq,
    hgap = 50,
    vgap = 30
  ) %>%
    left_join(node_levels, by = \name\) %>%
    mutate(
      y = level,
      x = as.numeric(factor(name))
    )

  # Plot
  p <- ggraph(g, layout = \manual\, x = layout$x, y = layout$y) +
    # Regular edges (with curvature)
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
        strength = curve_strength,  # <- include it here!
        filter = !edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = \closed\,
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        angle = 20
      ),
      end_cap = circle(8, 'mm'),
      start_cap = circle(8, 'mm'),
      lineend = \round\,
      linejoin = \round\
    )+
    # Self-loops
   geom_edge_loop(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
        strength = 1.2,            # <- keep here
        filter = edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = \closed\,
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        ends = \last\
      ),
      start_cap = circle(12, 'mm'),
      end_cap = circle(5, 'mm'),
      lineend = \round\,
      linejoin = \round\,
      n = 100
    ) +
    # Edge aesthetics
    scale_edge_linetype_manual(
      name = \Transition Type\,
      values = c(\solid\, \solid\, \solid\, \solid\),
      labels = c(
        \From Secretory To Absorptive\,
        \From Secretory To Secretory\,
        \From Secretory To Stem\,
        \From Absorptive To Stem\,
        \Other transitions\
      ),
      guide = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(edge_width = 1.5, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_identity(
      name = \Transition Type\,
      breaks = c(\#1B9E77\, \#D95F02\, \#7570B3\, \#E7298A\, \gray\),
      labels = c(
        \From Secretory To Absorptive\,
        \From Secretory To Secretory\,
        \From Secretory To Stem\,
        \From Absorptive To Stem\,
        \Other transitions\
      ),
      guide = \none\
    ) +
    scale_edge_width(
      range = c(0.3, 3),
      name = \Frequency\,
      guide = guide_legend(order = 2)
    ) +
    # Node aesthetics
    geom_node_point(
      size = 12,
      color = \white\,
      fill = \darkred\,
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 1
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = name),
      color = \black\,
      size = 4.5,
      fontface = \bold\,
      family = \sans\,
      repel = TRUE,
      box.padding = 0.5
    ) +
    # Theme
    theme_void() +
    labs(
      title = condition,
      subtitle = \Hierarchical transition network\
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = \right\,
      plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 2), \cm\),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.5, \cm\)
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1.2)

  return(p)
}

plot_dox_plus <- plot_transition_network(
  transitions_filtered %>% filter(Dox == \48hDox\), 
  \48hDox\
)
plot_dox_chase <- plot_transition_network(
  transitions_filtered %>% filter(Dox == \48hDox-72hChase\), 
  \48hDox-72hChase\
)

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
int_meta_DCM2_4

integrated_seurat
# 1. Extract UMAP coordinates
umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(integrated_seurat, \umap\))
umap_df$cell_id <- rownames(umap_df)

# 2. Extract metadata and merge
meta <- integrated_seurat@meta.data
meta$cell_id <- rownames(meta)

merged_df <- merge(umap_df, meta, by = \cell_id\)
merged_df$biotype <- merged_df$Dataset2
merged_df$biotype <- recode(merged_df$biotype,
                            \Large_dataset\ = \Ref\,
                            \Atlas_dataset\ = \Ref\,
                            \pRNA\ = \RNA\,
                            \pDCM\ = \DCM\)


# 3. Identify paired cells (same original identity but different sources)
paired_cells <- merged_df %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, all(c(\RNA\, \DCM\) %in% biotype)) %>%
  arrange(Sample_RNA, biotype)

# 4. Prepare arrows
arrow_df <- paired_cells %>%
  summarise(
    x = umap_1[biotype == \RNA\],
    y = umap_2[biotype == \RNA\],
    xend = umap_1[biotype == \DCM\],
    yend = umap_2[biotype == \DCM\]
  )

# 5. Custom colors
# Use default cluster colors
n_clusters <- length(unique(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))
gray_shades <- gray.colors(n_clusters, start = 0.8, end = 0.2)  # light to dark grays
names(gray_shades) <- sort(unique(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))
names(cluster_colors) <- levels(as.factor(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))

# 6. Mark RNA/DCM paired for styling
merged_df$pair_status <- \normal\
merged_df$pair_status[merged_df$cell_id %in% paired_cells$cell_id[paired_cells$biotype == \RNA\]] <- \RNA_pair\
merged_df$pair_status[merged_df$cell_id %in% paired_cells$cell_id[paired_cells$biotype == \DCM\]] <- \DCM_pair\

# 7. Plot
ggplot() +
  # Normal points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == \normal\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = as.factor(cell_identity_int2)),
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +

  # RNA paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == \RNA_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkred\, fill = \darkred\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # DCM paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == \DCM_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkgreen\, fill = \darkgreen\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # Arrows between RNA and DCM
  geom_segment(data = arrow_df,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, \cm\)),
               color = \black\, size = 0.3) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = gray_shades) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = \right\) +
  labs(title = \UMAP with RNA/DCM cell pairs connected\,
       color = \Cluster\)

```r

int_meta_DCM2_4
merged_df$cell_classification <- merged_df$cell_identity_int2
merged_df$cell_classification <- recode(merged_df$cell_classification,
                                        \ISC\ = \ISC\,
                                        \Enterocyte\ = \Absorptive\,
                                        \Paneth\ = \Secretory\,
                                        \Enteroendocrine\ = \Secretory\,
                                        \Tuft\ = \Secretory\,
                                        \Goblet\ = \Secretory\)

merged_df_filtered <- merged_df %>%
  filter(
    (biotype != \DCM\) | 
    (biotype == \DCM\ & cell_id %in% rownames(int_meta_DCM2_4))
  )

# 3. Identify paired cells (same original identity but different sources)
merged_df

# Step 1: Filter to pairs only
paired_cells <- merged_df_filtered %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, all(c(\RNA\, \DCM\) %in% biotype)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: Filter for only Secretory (DCM) → Absorptive (RNA) transitions
filtered_pairs <- paired_cells %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(
    (biotype == \DCM\ & cell_classification == \Secretory\) |
    (biotype == \RNA\ & cell_classification == \Absorptive\)
  ) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%  # Ensure both conditions are met
  ungroup()

# 4. Prepare arrows
arrow_df <- filtered_pairs %>%
  summarise(
    x = umap_1[biotype == \DCM\],
    y = umap_2[biotype == \DCM\],
    xend = umap_1[biotype == \RNA\],
    yend = umap_2[biotype == \RNA\]
  )

# 5. Custom colors
# Use default cluster colors
n_clusters <- length(unique(merged_df_filtered$cell_identity_int2))
gray_shades <- gray.colors(n_clusters, start = 0.8, end = 0.2)  # light to dark grays
names(gray_shades) <- sort(unique(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))
names(cluster_colors) <- levels(as.factor(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))

# 6. Mark RNA/DCM paired for styling
merged_df_filtered$pair_status <- \normal\
merged_df_filtered$pair_status[merged_df_filtered$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \RNA\]] <- \RNA_pair\
merged_df_filtered$pair_status[merged_df_filtered$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \DCM\]] <- \DCM_pair\

# 7. Plot
ggplot() +
  # Normal points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \normal\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = as.factor(cell_identity_int2)),
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +

  # RNA paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \RNA_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkred\, fill = \darkred\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # DCM paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \DCM_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkgreen\, fill = \darkgreen\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # Arrows between RNA and DCM
  geom_segment(data = arrow_df,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, \cm\)),
               color = \black\, size = 0.3) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = gray_shades) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    #plot.title =  element_blank(),
    axis.text =  element_blank(),
    axis.ticks =  element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line =  element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11),
    legend.position = \right\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, \cm\))+
  theme(legend.position = \right\) +
  labs(title = \Secretory to Absorptive pairs\,
       color = \Cell Type\)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\secretory_to_absorptive_umap.pdf\),dpi=300, width=5, heigh=3)

```r
# Step 1: Filter to pairs only
paired_cells <- merged_df_filtered %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, all(c(\RNA\, \DCM\) %in% biotype)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: Filter for only Secretory (DCM) → Absorptive (RNA) transitions
filtered_pairs <- paired_cells %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(
    (biotype == \DCM\ & cell_classification == \Secretory\) |
    (biotype == \RNA\ & cell_classification == \Secretory\)
  ) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%  # Ensure both conditions are met
  ungroup()

# 4. Prepare arrows
arrow_df <- filtered_pairs %>%
  summarise(
    x = umap_1[biotype == \DCM\],
    y = umap_2[biotype == \DCM\],
    xend = umap_1[biotype == \RNA\],
    yend = umap_2[biotype == \RNA\]
  )

# 5. Custom colors
# Use default cluster colors
n_clusters <- length(unique(merged_df_filtered$cell_identity_int2))
gray_shades <- gray.colors(n_clusters, start = 0.8, end = 0.2)  # light to dark grays
names(gray_shades) <- sort(unique(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))
names(cluster_colors) <- levels(as.factor(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))

# 6. Mark RNA/DCM paired for styling
merged_df_filtered$pair_status <- \normal\
merged_df_filtered$pair_status[merged_df_filtered$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \RNA\]] <- \RNA_pair\
merged_df_filtered$pair_status[merged_df_filtered$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \DCM\]] <- \DCM_pair\

# 7. Plot
ggplot() +
  # Normal points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \normal\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = as.factor(cell_identity_int2)),
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +

  # RNA paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \RNA_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkred\, fill = \darkred\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # DCM paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \DCM_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkgreen\, fill = \darkgreen\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # Arrows between RNA and DCM
  geom_segment(data = arrow_df,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, \cm\)),
               color = \black\, size = 0.3) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = gray_shades) +
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    #plot.title =  element_blank(),
    axis.text =  element_blank(),
    axis.ticks =  element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line =  element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11),
    legend.position = \right\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, \cm\))+
  theme(legend.position = \right\) +
  labs(title = \Secretory to Secretory pairs\,
       color = \Cell Type\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\secretory_to_Secretory_umap.pdf\),dpi=300, width=5, heigh=3)

# 6. Mark RNA/DCM paired for styling
merged_df_filtered$pair_status <- \normal\
merged_df_filtered$pair_status[merged_df_filtered$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \RNA\]] <- \RNA_pair\
merged_df_filtered$pair_status[merged_df_filtered$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \DCM\]] <- \DCM_pair\

# 7. Plot
ggplot() +
  # Normal points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \normal\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = as.factor(cell_identity_int2)),
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +

  # RNA paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \RNA_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkred\, fill = \darkred\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # DCM paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \DCM_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkgreen\, fill = \darkgreen\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # Arrows between RNA and DCM
  geom_segment(data = arrow_df,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, \cm\)),
               color = \black\, size = 0.3) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = gray_shades) +
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    #plot.title =  element_blank(),
    axis.text =  element_blank(),
    axis.ticks =  element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line =  element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11),
    legend.position = \right\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, \cm\))+
  theme(legend.position = \right\) +
  labs(title = \Secretory to ISC pairs\,
       color = \Cell Type\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\secretory_to_ISC_umap.pdf\),dpi=300, width=5, heigh=3)

```r
paired_cells <- merged_df_filtered %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, all(c(\RNA\, \DCM\) %in% biotype)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: Filter for only Secretory (DCM) → Absorptive (RNA) transitions
filtered_pairs <- paired_cells %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(
    (biotype == \DCM\ & cell_classification == \Absorptive\) |
    (biotype == \RNA\ & cell_classification == \ISC\)
  ) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%  # Ensure both conditions are met
  ungroup()

# 4. Prepare arrows
arrow_df <- filtered_pairs %>%
  summarise(
    x = umap_1[biotype == \DCM\],
    y = umap_2[biotype == \DCM\],
    xend = umap_1[biotype == \RNA\],
    yend = umap_2[biotype == \RNA\]
  )

# 5. Custom colors
# Use default cluster colors
n_clusters <- length(unique(merged_df_filtered$cell_identity_int2))
gray_shades <- gray.colors(n_clusters, start = 0.8, end = 0.2)  # light to dark grays
names(gray_shades) <- sort(unique(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))
names(cluster_colors) <- levels(as.factor(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))

# 6. Mark RNA/DCM paired for styling
merged_df_filtered$pair_status <- \normal\
merged_df_filtered$pair_status[merged_df_filtered$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \RNA\]] <- \RNA_pair\
merged_df_filtered$pair_status[merged_df_filtered$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \DCM\]] <- \DCM_pair\

# 7. Plot
ggplot() +
  # Normal points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \normal\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = as.factor(cell_identity_int2)),
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +

  # RNA paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \RNA_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkred\, fill = \darkred\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # DCM paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \DCM_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkgreen\, fill = \darkgreen\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # Arrows between RNA and DCM
  geom_segment(data = arrow_df,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, \cm\)),
               color = \black\, size = 0.3) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = gray_shades) +
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    #plot.title =  element_blank(),
    axis.text =  element_blank(),
    axis.ticks =  element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line =  element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11),
    legend.position = \right\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, \cm\))+
  theme(legend.position = \right\) +
  labs(title = \Absorptive to ISC pairs\,
       color = \Cell Type\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Absorptive_to_ISC_umap.pdf\),dpi=300, width=5, heigh=3)

```r
# Step 2: Filter for only Secretory (DCM) → Absorptive (RNA) transitions
paired_cells <- merged_df_filtered%>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, all(c(\RNA\, \DCM\) %in% biotype)) %>%
  ungroup()

paired_cells <- merged_df%>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, all(c(\RNA\, \DCM\) %in% biotype)) %>%
  ungroup()


filtered_pairs <- paired_cells %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(
    (biotype == \DCM\ & cell_classification == \ISC\) |
    (biotype == \RNA\ & cell_classification %in% c(\Secretory\,\Absorptive\))
  ) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%  # Ensure both conditions are met
  ungroup()

# 4. Prepare arrows
arrow_df <- filtered_pairs %>%
  summarise(
    x = umap_1[biotype == \DCM\],
    y = umap_2[biotype == \DCM\],
    xend = umap_1[biotype == \RNA\],
    yend = umap_2[biotype == \RNA\]
  )

# 5. Custom colors
# Use default cluster colors
n_clusters <- length(unique(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))
gray_shades <- gray.colors(n_clusters, start = 0.8, end = 0.2)  # light to dark grays
names(gray_shades) <- sort(unique(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))
names(cluster_colors) <- levels(as.factor(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))

# 6. Mark RNA/DCM paired for styling
merged_df$pair_status <- \normal\
merged_df$pair_status[merged_df$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \RNA\]] <- \RNA_pair\
merged_df$pair_status[merged_df$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \DCM\]] <- \DCM_pair\

# 7. Plot
ggplot() +
  # Normal points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == \normal\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = as.factor(cell_identity_int2)),
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +

  # RNA paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == \RNA_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkred\, fill = \darkred\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # DCM paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == \DCM_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkgreen\, fill = \darkgreen\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # Arrows between RNA and DCM
  geom_segment(data = arrow_df,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, \cm\)),
               color = \black\, size = 0.3) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = gray_shades) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    #plot.title =  element_blank(),
    axis.text =  element_blank(),
    axis.ticks =  element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line =  element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11),
    legend.position = \right\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, \cm\))+
  theme(legend.position = \right\) +
  labs(title = \ISC to Absorptive and Secretory pairs\,
       color = \Cell Type\)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\ISC_to_secretory_and_absorptive_nofilter_umap.pdf\),dpi=300, width=5, heigh=3)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\ISC_to_secretory_and_absorptive_filter_umap.pdf\),dpi=300, width=5, heigh=3)
