paired_cells <- merged_df%>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, all(c(\RNA\, \DCM\) %in% biotype)) %>%
  ungroup()


paired_cells <- merged_df_filtered %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, all(c(\RNA\, \DCM\) %in% biotype)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: Filter for only Secretory (DCM) → Absorptive (RNA) transitions
filtered_pairs <- paired_cells %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(
    (biotype == \DCM\ & cell_identity_int2 %in% c(\Goblet\)) |
    (biotype == \RNA\ & cell_identity_int2 %in% c(\Tuft\))
  ) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%  # Ensure both conditions are met
  ungroup()

# 4. Prepare arrows
arrow_df <- filtered_pairs %>%
  summarise(
    x = umap_1[biotype == \DCM\],
    y = umap_2[biotype == \DCM\],
    xend = umap_1[biotype == \RNA\],
    yend = umap_2[biotype == \RNA\]
  )

# 5. Custom colors
# Use default cluster colors
n_clusters <- length(unique(merged_df_filtered$cell_identity_int2))
gray_shades <- gray.colors(n_clusters, start = 0.8, end = 0.2)  # light to dark grays
names(gray_shades) <- sort(unique(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))
names(cluster_colors) <- levels(as.factor(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))

# 6. Mark RNA/DCM paired for styling
merged_df$pair_status <- \normal\
merged_df$pair_status[merged_df$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \RNA\]] <- \RNA_pair\
merged_df$pair_status[merged_df$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \DCM\]] <- \DCM_pair\

# 7. Plot
ggplot() +
  # Normal points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \normal\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = as.factor(cell_identity_int2)),
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.1) +

  # RNA paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \RNA_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkred\, fill = \darkred\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # DCM paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df_filtered %>% filter(pair_status == \DCM_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkgreen\, fill = \darkgreen\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # Arrows between RNA and DCM
  geom_segment(data = arrow_df,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, \cm\)),
               color = \black\, size = 0.3) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = publication_colors_27) +
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    #plot.title =  element_blank(),
    axis.text =  element_blank(),
    axis.ticks =  element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line =  element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11),
    legend.position = \right\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, \cm\))+
  theme(legend.position = \right\) +
  labs(title = \Goblet to Tuft\,
       color = \Cell Type\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Goblet_to_Tuft_umap.pdf\),dpi=300, width=5, heigh=3)

```r
paired_cells_filt <- paired_cells[paired_cells$Sample_RNA %in% paste0(\RNA_\,colnames(Palantir_scback_filter)),]

filtered_pairs <- paired_cells_filt %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(
    (biotype == \DCM\ & cell_identity_int2 %in% c(\Paneth\,\Enterocyte\,\Goblet\,\Tuft\,\Enteroendocrine\) |
    (biotype == \RNA\ & cell_identity_int2 %in% c(\ISC\))
  )) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%  # Ensure both conditions are met
  ungroup()

# 4. Prepare arrows
arrow_df <- filtered_pairs %>%
  summarise(
    x = umap_1[biotype == \DCM\],
    y = umap_2[biotype == \DCM\],
    xend = umap_1[biotype == \RNA\],
    yend = umap_2[biotype == \RNA\]
  )


# 6. Mark RNA/DCM paired for styling
merged_df$pair_status <- \normal\
merged_df$pair_status[merged_df$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \RNA\]] <- \RNA_pair\
merged_df$pair_status[merged_df$cell_id %in% filtered_pairs$cell_id[filtered_pairs$biotype == \DCM\]] <- \DCM_pair\


# 7. Plot
ggplot() +
  # Normal points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == \normal\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = as.factor(cell_identity_int2)),
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.1) +

  # RNA paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == \RNA_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkred\, fill = \darkred\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # DCM paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == \DCM_pair\),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = \darkgreen\, fill = \darkgreen\,
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # Arrows between RNA and DCM
  geom_segment(data = arrow_df,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, \cm\)),
               color = \black\, size = 0.3) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = publication_colors_28) +
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    #plot.title =  element_blank(),
    axis.text =  element_blank(),
    axis.ticks =  element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line =  element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \plain\, size = 11),
    legend.position = \right\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, \cm\))+
  theme(legend.position = \right\) +
  labs(title = \Rest -> ISC\,
       color = \Cell Type\)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\ISC_rest_umap_filtered.png\),dpi=300, width=5, heigh=3)

comeback <- c(    \RNA_B17_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_B20_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_C15_Plate_1\,
    \RNA_H20_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_P18_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_C15_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_D14_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_G8_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_O6_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_F24_Plate_2\)
comeback_filter <- c(
    \RNA_C15_Plate_1\,
    \RNA_P18_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_C15_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_G8_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_O6_Plate_2\,
    \RNA_F24_Plate_2\)


heatmap_data_t_comeback <- heatmap_data_t[,colnames(heatmap_data_t) %in% comeback]
annotation_col$cellid <- rownames(annotation_col)
annotation_col_comeback <-  annotation_col[rownames(annotation_col) %in% comeback,]
annotation_col_comeback$cellid <- NULL
annotation_col_comeback <- factor(unique(annotation_col_comeback))
annotation_col_comeback$CCAvsMS <- c(\Concordant\,\Concordant\,\Concordant\,\Concordant\,\Hybrid\,\Concordant\,\Discordant\,\Discordant\,\Discordant\,\Hybrid\)
annotation_col_comeback$CCAvsMS <- factor(annotation_col_comeback$CCAvsMS, levels=unique(annotation_col_comeback$CCAvsMS))
annotation_col_comeback
annotation_col_comeback$Transition <- factor(annotation_col_comeback$Transition)
transition_colors_comeback <- list(
  Transition = setNames(c(\#88CCEE\,\#1F78B4\,\#80B1D3\,\#E78AC3\), unique(annotation_col_comeback$Transition)),
  CCAvsMS = setNames(c( \#1B9E77\, \#D95F02\,\#CC6677\), unique(annotation_col_comeback$CCAvsMS)))


transition_cells_all_comeback$transition <- factor(transition_cells_all_comeback$transition, levels = unique(transition_cells_all_comeback$transition))
transition_cells_all_comeback <- transition_cells_all[transition_cells_all$Sample_RNA %in% comeback,]
transition_colors_comeback <- transition_colors[names(transition_colors) %in% unique(transition_cells_all_comeback $transition)]
heatmap_data_RNA_t_comeback <- heatmap_data_RNA_t[,colnames(heatmap_data_RNA_t) %in% comeback]


heatmap_data_t_comeback2 <- heatmap_data_t_comeback[order,]

pdf(file.path(output_dir,\plate_heatmap_all_transitions_MS_DCM_t_comeback2_25042025.pdf\), width = 5, height = 5)  # Adjust width/height as needed

pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_t_comeback2,
  annotation_col = annotation_col_comeback,
  color = colorRampPalette(c(\blue\, \white\, \red\))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # Keep Tuft1/Goblet1 order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Disable column clustering (use manual order)
  show_colnames = TRUE,  # Hide cell IDs
  scale=\column\,
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(transition_cells_all_comeback$transition)),  # Add gaps between transition groups
  main = \Transitions Module Scores DCM\,
  annotation_colors = transition_colors_comeback,
       cellheight = 12,
     fontsize_row = 7,  # Adjust if row labels are too large
  fontsize_col = 8,  # For column annotations if shown
  margins = c(500, 300),
 #legend_breaks = c(z_min, z_max),  # ONLY show min and max
  #legend_labels = c(round(z_min,2), round(z_max,2)),
  legend = TRUE,
  fontsize = 8,                # Smaller font for legend labels
  keysize = 0.5,               # Width of color key (default=1.5)
  keyheight = 0.2,             # Height of color key (default=0.5)
  keypar = list(cex = 0.5),    # Shrink legend elements
  margins = c(5, 10)           # Adjust plot margins if needed
# Format to 2 decimals# Bottom/right margins (increase if elements are cut off)
)
dev.off()

```r
annotation_df_sc_filt <- annotation_df_sc[annotation_df_sc$MS_DCM == \Concordant\,]
Palantir_scbackfilt <- Palantir_scback[,colnames(Palantir_scback) %in% rownames(annotation_df_sc_filt) ]
RNA_velocity_scbackfilt <- RNA_velocity_scback[,colnames(RNA_velocity_scback) %in% rownames(annotation_df_sc_filt) ]
Cytotrace_scbackfilt <- Cytotrace_scback[,colnames(Cytotrace_scback) %in% rownames(annotation_df_sc_filt) ]


umap_coords_integrated <- integrated_seurat@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
umap_coords_integrated <- data.frame(umap_coords_integrated)
# Example: a data frame of UMAP coordinates per cell
umap_cells <- data.frame(
  cell_id = rownames(umap_coords_integrated),          # same order as columns in pred_mat
  UMAP_1 = umap_coords_integrated$umap_1,                          # fill with your real UMAP_1 values
  UMAP_2 = umap_coords_integrated$umap_2,                          # fill with your real UMAP_2 values
  cell_type = integrated_seurat$cell_identity_int2                        # categorical label per cell (e.g., predicted or annotated cluster)
)


centroids <- umap_cells %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    x = mean(UMAP_1),
    y = mean(UMAP_2)
  ) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = paste0(cell_type, \_pre\))  # Add \_pre\ suffix

isc_center <- data.frame(
  cell_type = \ISC\,
  x = mean(umap_cells$UMAP_1),  # or set a known fixed point
  y = mean(umap_cells$UMAP_2)
)

nodes <- bind_rows(isc_center, centroids)

weights <- rowMeans(Palantir_scbackfilt)
weights_cy <- rowMeans(Cytotrace_scbackfilt)
weights_Vel <- rowMeans(RNA_velocity_scbackfilt)

edges <- data.frame(
  from = \ISC\,
  to = paste0(names(weights),\_pre\),
  weight = weights
)

edges_cy <- data.frame(
  from = \ISC\,
  to = paste0(names(weights_cy),\_pre\),
  weight = weights_cy
)
edges_vel <- data.frame(
  from = \ISC\,
  to = paste0(names(weights_Vel),\_pre\),
  weight = weights_Vel
)

# Add coordinates
edges <- edges %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c(\from\ = \cell_type\)) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c(\to\ = \cell_type\)) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)
# Add coordinates
edges_cy <- edges_cy %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c(\from\ = \cell_type\)) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c(\to\ = \cell_type\)) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)
# Add coordinates
edges_vel <- edges_vel %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c(\from\ = \cell_type\)) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c(\to\ = \cell_type\)) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)

cell_types <- c(\ISC\, \Paneth\, \Enterocyte\, \Goblet\, \Tuft\, \Enteroendocrine\)
cell_type_colors <- c(\#88CCEE\, \#44AA99\, \#117733\, \#999933\, \#DDCC77\, \#CC6677\)
names(cell_type_colors) <- cell_types
edges$pred_type <- gsub(\_pre$\, \\, edges$to)
edges_cy$pred_type <- gsub(\_pre$\, \\, edges_cy$to)
edges_vel$pred_type <- gsub(\_pre$\, \\, edges_vel$to)



library(scales)
edges$weight_scaled <- rescale(edges$weight, to = c(0.5, 3))  # adjust range as needed
edges_cy$weight_scaled <- rescale(edges_cy$weight, to = c(0.5, 3))  # adjust range as needed
edges_vel$weight_scaled <- rescale(edges_vel$weight, to = c(0.5, 3))  # adjust range as needed


p <- ggplot() +
  # Optional: background UMAP points
  geom_point(data = umap_cells, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2), color = \gray90\, size = 0.3) +

  # Arrows from ISC to predicted cell types
  geom_segment(data = edges_vel,
               aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end,
                   size = weight, color = pred_type),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, \cm\))) +

  # Node points
  geom_point(data = nodes, aes(x = x, y = y), color = \steelblue\, size = 4) +
  geom_text(data = nodes, aes(x = x, y = y, label = cell_type), vjust = -1, size = 1.8) +

  # Manual color scale
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_type_colors) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3)) +

   theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    plot.title =  element_blank(),
    axis.text =  element_blank(),
    axis.ticks =  element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line =  element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \bold\, size = 8),
    legend.position = \right\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, \cm\)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = \Predicted Cell Type Flow from ISC\,
       color = \Predicted Type\)

 # Save the plot
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)

# Extract all legend boxes
  legends <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == \guide-box\)]

# Save each legend manually (they're stacked in one box)
  legend_combined <- legends[[1]]  # Usually contains both

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Umap_palantir_prediction_per_cluster_legend.png\),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =2.15, height = 1.5)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = \none\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Umap_palantir_prediction_per_cluster.png\), p_nolegend,dpi=300,width = 3, height = 3)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Umap_cytotrace_prediction_per_cluster_legend.png\),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =2.15, height = 1.5)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = \none\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Umap_cytotrace_prediction_per_cluster.png\), p_nolegend,dpi=300,width = 3, height = 3)

```r
annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_RNA <- factor(annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_RNA, levels = unique(annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_RNA))

annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_DCM <- factor(annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_DCM, levels = unique(annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_DCM))

dcm_isc_freq <- as.data.frame(table(DCM = annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_DCM, ISC_RNA = annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_RNA))
colnames(dcm_isc_freq) <- c(\from\, \to\, \weight\)

unique_dcm <- unique(dcm_isc_freq$from)
dcm_nodes <- data.frame(
  cell_type = paste0(unique_dcm,\_DCM\),
  x = seq(min(umap_cells$UMAP_1), max(umap_cells$UMAP_1), length.out = length(unique_dcm)),
  y = max(umap_cells$UMAP_2) + 3  # position above the UMAP
)

dcm_edges <- dcm_isc_freq %>%
  left_join(dcm_nodes, by = c(\from\ = \cell_type\)) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c(\to\ = \cell_type\)) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)

ggplot() +
  # Background UMAP
  geom_point(data = umap_cells, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2), color = \gray90\, size = 0.3) +

  # Arrows from DCM → ISC
  geom_segment(data = dcm_edges,
               aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end, size = weight),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, \cm\)), color = \gray40\, alpha = 0.6) +

  # Arrows from ISC → Predicted
  geom_segment(data = edges,
               aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end,
                   size = weight, color = pred_type),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, \cm\))) +

  # All nodes (DCM + ISC + Predicted)
  geom_point(data = bind_rows(nodes, dcm_nodes), aes(x = x, y = y), color = \steelblue\, size = 4) +
  geom_text(data = bind_rows(nodes, dcm_nodes), aes(x = x, y = y, label = cell_type), vjust = -1) +

  scale_color_manual(values = cell_type_colors) +
  guides(size = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = \DCM → RNA → Prediction Flow\, color = \Predicted Cell Type\)

dcm_edges <- dcm_isc_freq %>%
  mutate(from_dcm = paste0(from, \_DCM\)) %>%  # <-- key fix
  left_join(dcm_nodes, by = c(\from_dcm\ = \cell_type\)) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c(\to\ = \cell_type\)) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)

dcm_nodes <- data.frame(cell_type = unique(dcm_edges$from_dcm))

dcm_nodes$pred_type <- gsub(\_DCM$\, \\, dcm_nodes$cell_type)

umap_centroids <- umap_cells %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    x = median(UMAP_1),
    y = median(UMAP_2)
  )

dcm_nodes <- dcm_nodes %>%
  left_join(umap_centroids, by = c(\pred_type\ = \cell_type\)) %>%
  mutate(
    x = x ,  # jitter to separate overlapping nodes
    y = y
  )

dcm_nodes$y[1] <- 2.19
dcm_nodes$y[2] <- -12.5

dcm_edges$y_start[1] <- 2.19
dcm_edges$y_start[2] <- -12.5
dcm_edges$x_start[1] <- 8.515996
dcm_edges$x_start[2] <- -3.114715


############
p <- ggplot() +
  # UMAP background
  geom_point(
    data = umap_cells, 
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2), 
    color = \gray90\, 
    size = 0.3
  ) +

  # Arrows: DCM → ISC (fixed size, alpha = weight)
  geom_segment(
    data = dcm_edges,
    aes(
      x = x_start, 
      y = y_start, 
      xend = c(1,-0.10),  # Stop before node
      yend = c(0.5,-2),
      alpha = weight        # Transparency ~ weight
    ),
    linewidth = 1,        # Fixed thickness (adjust as needed)
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.15, \cm\),  
      type = \closed\,          
      angle = 20                
    ),
    color = c( \#E0A4A4\),       # Fixed color
    linetype = \3313\,      # Dashed style
    lineend = \butt\        # Sharp edges
  ) +

  # Arrows: ISC → Predicted (fixed size, alpha = weight)
  geom_segment(
    data = edges_vel,
    aes(
      x = x_start, 
      y = y_start, 
      xend = x_end * 0.8,     
      yend = y_end * 0.8,
      alpha = weight_scaled,        # Transparency ~ weight
      color = \#A4E0D8\      # Color by cell type (optional)
    ),
    linewidth = 1,        # Same thickness as above
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.15, \cm\),  
      angle = 20,
      type = \closed\
    ),
    lineend = \butt\        
  ) +

  # Nodes and labels (unchanged)
  geom_point(
    data = bind_rows(nodes, dcm_nodes), 
    aes(x = x, y = y), 
    size = 4, 
    color = c(\#88CCEE\,\#88CCEE\, \#117733\,\#999933\,\#44AA99\, \#DDCC77\, \#CC6677\,\#117733\,\#44AA99\)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = bind_rows(nodes, dcm_nodes), 
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = cell_type), 
    vjust = -1, size=2
  ) +

  # Styling adjustments
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_type_colors) +  # For pred_type colors
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.5, 3)) +               # Alpha range (adjust min/max transparency)
  guides(
    size = \none\,                               # Hide size legend
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    title = \Flow from DCM → RNA → Prediction\, 
    color = \Predicted Cell Type\
  ) +

   theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    plot.title =  element_blank(),
    axis.text =  element_blank(),
    axis.ticks =  element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line =  element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(face = \bold\, size = 8),
    legend.position = \right\,
    legend.box = \horizontal\,
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, \cm\),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, \cm\),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, \cm\)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = \Predicted Cell Type Flow from ISC\,
       color = \Predicted Type\)


 # Save the plot
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)

# Extract all legend boxes
  legends <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == \guide-box\)]

# Save each legend manually (they're stacked in one box)
  legend_combined <- legends[[1]]  # Usually contains both

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Umap_cyto_prediction_per_clusterscback_legend.png\),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =2.15, height = 1.5)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = \none\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Umap_cyto_prediction_per_clusterscback.png\), p_nolegend,dpi=300,width = 3, height = 3)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Umap_velo_prediction_per_clusterscback_legend.png\),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =2.15, height = 1.5)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = \none\)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,\Umap_velo_prediction_per_clusterscback.png\), p_nolegend,dpi=300,width = 3, height = 3)
